- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/CmmmmmmLau/SulFur_Battle_improvement/issues/5

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
-almost consistently when i return the game freezes, i lose nothing tho except the time it takes to load up the game again.
**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behaviour:
-iguess return prematurely before finishing the area?
**Expected behaviour**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
-after pressing continue during the loading screen, the frame should be your weapon nearly drawn and what i assume is the grave you crawl out of after dying/returning.
**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.
**please complete the following information:**
- Game Version: [e.g. 0.10.4]
- Mod Version: [e.g. 1.4.3]
**Additional context**
If you have installed other mod, please provide it below

Comment 5 | author: cyraid | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/playgameservices/play-games-plugin-for-unity/issues/2029#issuecomment-516968731
I'm getting a NullReferenceException "UnityEditor.GameObjectInspector.ClearPreviewCache ()" after using PlayGameServices too. Happens on every run. Using Unity 2019.2.0f1
Edit: As Antonz0 was mentioning, you could probably even stick EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode at the top with a return. Because it's an "InitializeOnLoad", and that's getting called on play mode, which wouldn't make sense for the upgrader to run anyway.
So stick:
```
if (EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode)
return;
```
At the top of the static constructor GPGSUpgrader() and call it a day.
Edit: Although it still doesn't stop the random NRE's during script compile.

2021.3.12f1

Windows 11

iOS
### Description
Hi,
Only on iOS build (iPhone XR) when navigating between scenes several times (5-10 times), and one scene is initializing MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation sample, I get crash.
It is hard to get a log when the app crashes, but sometimes I get this errors (they are watched with Sentry, but almost always only one of them at once:
`System.InvalidOperationException: The table is full
File "GlobalInstanceTable.cs", line 36, in Add
File "Assembly-CSharp3.cpp", line 15896, in Start
File "GraphRunner.cs", line 99, in Start`
`System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
File "SolutionCustom.cs", line 101, in ReadFromImageSource
File "ImageSourceSolutionCustom.cs", line 110, in Run`
`System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
File "Assembly-CSharp1.cpp", in WaitForWebCamTexture { <lambda> }
...
(1 additional frame(s) were not displayed)`
Please, give some advice what can be a reason of that crash.
### Code to Reproduce the issue
_No response_
### Additional Context
_No response_
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: homuler | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/homuler/MediaPipeUnityPlugin/issues/814#issuecomment-1362750881
Is the error reproducible with the sample app (this unity project)?
It seems that you have changed some code and the change can be causing this issue.
In that case, please fill the `Code to Reproduce the issue` field.
> **Code to Reproduce the issue**
>
> _No response_
Comment 2 | author: homuler | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/homuler/MediaPipeUnityPlugin/issues/814#issuecomment-1366377196
> it is difficult to provide source code to reproduce.
It's OK, but note that I won't support you unless the necessary information is provided.
> How to, properly, change **in the sample app** scene from any of your scenes, to a scene without working/active Bootstrap and other components (like Solution, ImageSource etc.)?
The sample app uses the `Bootstrap` and `Solution` classes to switch and run scenes, so you can't do that.
Of course, if you rewrite or add some classes, you may be able to do that.
> I mean: how to disable properly your plugin?
I don't get what you mean. If you don't need to use the plugin, then you can just remove it from your project.
If you are referring to components under `Assets` by the word `plugin`, then you don't need to use them in the first place (cf. https://github.com/homuler/MediaPipeUnityPlugin/wiki/Getting-Started#tutorial).
Comment 3 | author: homuler | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/homuler/MediaPipeUnityPlugin/issues/814#issuecomment-1366411844
`Solution.Stop()` will stop MediaPipe, but to clear all the `Texture`s, at least you need to destroy `TextureFramePool`.
~However, the sample app does not assume `TextureFramePool` will be destroyed while the app is running, it may not work as you expect (maybe `TextureFrame` should be `IDisposable`?).~
Sorry, this is wrong.
`TextureFramePool` will be destroyed when the attached object (= `Solution`) is destroyed, but the pooled `TextureFrame`s are not necessarily destroyed at the same time (it depends on GC).
Comment 4 | author: homuler | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/homuler/MediaPipeUnityPlugin/issues/814#issuecomment-1366420409
If it is a problem, probably you need to destroy them explicitly here.
https://github.com/homuler/MediaPipeUnityPlugin/blob/42f9117fb2000a87c2dad5e024255f3c0a51600d/Assets/MediaPipeUnity/Samples/Common/Scripts/ImageSource/TextureFramePool.cs#L51-L68
Comment 5 | author: homuler | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/homuler/MediaPipeUnityPlugin/issues/814#issuecomment-1366437683
Again, can you reproduce it with the sample app (without any change)?
> It looks like for each scene change, one texture (from TextureFramePool probably) remains in memory:
That's because `TextureFrame` is not `IDisposable` and does not release the underlying `Texture2D` immediately (I agree that they should be released explicitly, but they aren't for now).
Comment 6 | author: homuler | association: OWNER | reactions: 2 | score: 17 | url: https://github.com/homuler/MediaPipeUnityPlugin/issues/814#issuecomment-1366452609
> one texture (from TextureFramePool probably) remains in memory
I'm not sure, but maybe the texture of the `Screen`?
https://github.com/homuler/MediaPipeUnityPlugin/blob/2c8a31ae5b4232fbffd97fdc6b4f2b8f1a6370b4/Assets/MediaPipeUnity/Samples/Common/Scripts/ImageSourceSolution.cs#L14

Comment 1 | author: snips86x | association: NONE | reactions: 2 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/valheimPlus/ValheimPlus/issues/709#issuecomment-1259495175
The screenshots you have provided relate to a patch that was dropped today for Valheim. You will need to opt-in to the 'previous stable' release via the Beta menu within the steams game properties and use the following to update the server to use the previous stable:
`app_update <app_id> [-beta <betaname>] [validate]`
Comment 2 | author: banspaugh | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 8 | url: https://github.com/valheimPlus/ValheimPlus/issues/709#issuecomment-1259963384
> The screenshots you have provided relate to a patch that was dropped today for Valheim. You will need to opt-in to the 'previous stable' release via the Beta menu within the steams game properties and use the following to update the server to use the previous stable: `app_update <app_id> [-beta <betaname>] [validate]`
Could someone let me know where to run this command `app_update <app_id> [-beta <betaname>] [validate]`
I use Gportal as a host and I'm not sure where to get in to run it. Is this even an option if I'm hosting with Gportal? TIA
Comment 3 | author: MartenBE | association: NONE | reactions: 18 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/valheimPlus/ValheimPlus/issues/709#issuecomment-1260163436
> I run a Valheim server in the local network. I use https://github.com/lloesche/valheim-server-docker for this - V+ is already integrated there. Since I am not able to use the previous version in the Docker container, I have now copied the saves from the server and activated V+ locally on my computer with the above workaround. It works for now.
If you use that docker container, it doesn't need to be so complicated. Just add the `STEAMCMD_ARGS` environment variable and restart the docker container:
```
version: "3"
services:
valheim:
image: lloesche/valheim-server:latest
ports:
- "2456-2457:2456-2457/udp"
- "8080:3000/tcp"
environment:
- "SERVER_NAME=A server"
- "SERVER_PASS=${PASSWORD}"
- "BEPINEX=false"
- "VALHEIM_PLUS=true"
- "STEAMCMD_ARGS=-beta default_old"
volumes:
- "./.files-valheim/config:/config"
- "./.files-valheim/data:/opt/valheim"
```
For each client, change Steam Beta Option (steps provided by the Discord channel):
1. Open steam library
2. Right click valheim
3. Manage
4. Betas
5. On the first field, click it to get the drop-down menu and change to `default_old`
Tested and works
Comment 4 | author: SSimp258 | association: NONE | reactions: 4 | score: 9 | url: https://github.com/valheimPlus/ValheimPlus/issues/709#issuecomment-1267304376
The reason it no longer works is the "default_old" version is now 211.7. The only workaround now is to get on the Valheim Plus Discord channel and get the alpha version. NX will be back this weekend to publish it. Once it gets published, Thunderstore and Nexus will work as normal.
Comment 5 | author: jdrusso | association: NONE | reactions: 6 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/valheimPlus/ValheimPlus/issues/709#issuecomment-1267820184
The following has temporarily resolved this for me with the https://github.com/lloesche/valheim-server-docker server container, using the alpha release DLL:
1. Attach to container (`docker exec -it valheim /bin/bash`)
2. Replace the DLL in `/opt/valheim/plus/BepInEx/plugins` with the alpha release, from discord
3. Kill the currently running server with `kill $(cat /var/run/valheim/valheim-server.pid)`
The container will automatically run a new server process to restore the one you killed, which will load the new V+ DLL, and the logic to download V+ from github appears not to be run
I left `-beta default_old` on both the server + my client, but I'm not sure if it's necessary, I'm just lazy and it worked.
Comment 6 | author: avaryx | association: NONE | reactions: 4 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/valheimPlus/ValheimPlus/issues/709#issuecomment-1270082074
To follow up on what @jdrusso has provided, I did the following:
1. I downloaded the alpha `ValheimPlus.dll` from Discord
2. I backed up my current `ValeheimPlus.dll` in my server directory, and replaced it with the alpha version
3. I started up the container and the logs were fine
Note that the DLL is found here:
`./valheim-server/data/plus/BepInEx/plugins/ValheimPlus.dll`
I did not do anything with the `-beta default_old` settings but rather kept my server settings the same as they were before.

<!-- source=github_issue; title=MacOS docfx broken between 2.51 and 2.52; url=https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/issues/5785 -->

# MacOS docfx broken between 2.51 and 2.52

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/issues/5785

**Operation System**: (`Windows` or `Linux` or `MacOS`)
MacOS
**DocFX Version Used**:
2.52
#5637 introduced a [new version](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/commit/ffba70567a8157e659b78d6254d88ac8efeeec4a#diff-370fa3bbd2b361f76dff6127d96b19ceR30) of the FSharp compiler service (34.1.1), which seems to be incompatible with MacOS / mono fork of MSBuild (or does this now require an update to mono?). I used git bisect to track it down to this changeset: ffba7056.
The error received is:
```
20-04-16 03:21:06.424]Info:[MetadataCommand]Completed Scope:MetadataCommand in 705.8239 milliseconds.
[20-04-16 03:21:06.424]Error:Error extracting metadata for /Users/amir/Library/Application Support/unity/editor/documentation/build/com.unity.package-manager-doctools@1.1/package/solution.csproj: System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
at Microsoft.DocAsCode.Metadata.ManagedReference.ExtractMetadataWorker.SaveAllMembersFromCacheAsync () [0x00535] in <8a8478fd5e284acdb5322455028f571a>:0
at Microsoft.DocAsCode.Metadata.ManagedReference.ExtractMetadataWorker.ExtractMetadataAsync () [0x00106] in <8a8478fd5e284acdb5322455028f571a>:0
[20-04-16 03:21:06.424]Info:Completed in 709.2319 milliseconds
```
but this is simply because the project loader fails to load the project.
For now we'll have to stick with 2.51 until this is fixed.
Selected solution comments:

# [URP] Underwater Curtain/Meniscus broken in URP 7.4.1

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/wave-harmonic/crest/issues/531

**Describe the bug**
Underwater effects does not render. Both the curtain and meniscus.
**Screenshots / video**
![Bildschirmfoto_2020-06-05_um_10 51 07](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5249806/83934581-83e6f980-a7f5-11ea-9309-4caaa8cc4890.jpg)
**Log**
Nothing logged.
**Versions**
Crest 4.2
URP 7.4.1+
Unity 2019.4+
**To Reproduce**
Go underwater in main scene.
**Platform**
- Editor
- Mac
Haven't tested other platforms
**Additional Notes**
I checked the frame debugger, the curtain draw call is there but nothing renders. Also, 7.4.1 is not verified for 2019.4.
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: magenta404 | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/wave-harmonic/crest/issues/531#issuecomment-643301594
@Snigros No worries.
For anyone using 2019.4 and want this working, please consider using URP 7.3 (verified for 2019.4). I couldn't see anything in the change log that would be the cause. I will most likely submit a bug to Unity tomorrow.
Comment 2 | author: magenta404 | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/wave-harmonic/crest/issues/531#issuecomment-646050249
@NiekoEugenijus Thanks. I have already handled that exception which will be fixed for 4.4. That cbuffer notice won't be the issue either.
I'll check again tomorrow. I think it might have something to do with the vertex part of the shader.
Comment 3 | author: magenta404 | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/wave-harmonic/crest/issues/531#issuecomment-647072235
I couldn't work this out so I submitted a bug to Unity today. I will post here with updates.
Comment 4 | author: magenta404 | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/wave-harmonic/crest/issues/531#issuecomment-663523134
I had another look and it looks like the `unity_CameraToWorld._13_23_33` is inverted. If I invert it, it works correctly. I am under the assumption that this matrix is safe to use without being concerned about platform specific issues like z-flipping. So I am hesitant to fix it as it could be working fine for most people despite the number of reports we get. I have updated the case with Unity.
We could pass the camera forward in ourselves with scripting. I might resort to that if I hear nothing from Unity before the next release.
Comment 5 | author: magenta404 | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/wave-harmonic/crest/issues/531#issuecomment-674145247
Fix will still be in for 4.5 and beyond. But here is the Unity issue for this bug:
https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/product/unity/issues/guid/1257518
Comment 6 | author: magenta404 | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/wave-harmonic/crest/issues/531#issuecomment-674966758
4.5 is released which solves this issue. Eventually we can revert this fix once Unity has fixed it on their end.

<!-- source=github_issue; title=Adding a new Unity type from template via the solution explorer is always named 'a'; url=https://github.com/JetBrains/resharper-unity/issues/328 -->

# Adding a new Unity type from template via the solution explorer is always named 'a'

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/JetBrains/resharper-unity/issues/328

When adding a new type (Class, Behaviour C# Script, PlaymodeTest, Shader, etc.) via the Solution Explorer window in Visual Studio 2017 by either pressing the generate shortcut (Alt + insert on my machine) or right click and select _Add > New From Template_, the resulting type and namespaces are always just `a`.
It does not matter what I fill in the dialog that pops up; if I use (the default) `MonoBehaviour1` for a Behaviour C# Script, the resulting code will always be:
```
using UnityEngine;
namespace a
{
public class a : MonoBehaviour
{
}
}
```
The filename _does_ use the entered value.
Using the same method (for non-Unity types obviously) in non unity projects yields the expected type names.
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: citizenmatt | association: MEMBER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/JetBrains/resharper-unity/issues/328#issuecomment-357199835
Are there any exceptions reported? Look at the status bar and look for any flashing red exclamation mark icons. If there are, double click and let me know what's listed.
Also, do you have the heap view plugin installed? If so, please uninstall it. This error happens because something throws an exception half-way through the process of setting up the template - the `a` characters are placeholders that should get filled in and replaced with a "hotspot" for code completion. The heap view plugin is the only other plugin we have that I know about that could be breaking, and we know there are incompatibilities with it at the moment.
Comment 2 | author: citizenmatt | association: MEMBER | reactions: 0 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/JetBrains/resharper-unity/issues/328#issuecomment-357237492
Ah, I'd assumed you were in Rider, rather than ReSharper. I'm afraid I don't really know what's going wrong here - does the normal `Class` template work in a Unity project, or is it all templates in Unity projects that are broken? And does the `Class` template then work in a non-Unity project?
Comment 3 | author: citizenmatt | association: MEMBER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/JetBrains/resharper-unity/issues/328#issuecomment-357242337
Can you try running `devenv.exe /ReSharper.Internal` and create a file from a template, please? Exceptions are hidden by default in ReSharper, but if we enable internal mode, it should hopefully start showing exceptions again - look for the exclamation mark in the status bar.
Comment 4 | author: citizenmatt | association: MEMBER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/JetBrains/resharper-unity/issues/328#issuecomment-357272003
Hmm. We have another issue which looks to be the same as this: [RSRP-467875](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/RSRP-467875), with the same exceptions
I notice that you're using ReSharper 2017.2.2. You could try updating to 2017.3, but the linked issue is on 2017.3, and it's still happening there.
It looks like it's throwing an exception when it's trying to modify the file, and the top exception is failing in a method called `TryCheckOut`. Do you have source control enabled on this project? What provider are you using? Can you try it with the source control integration disabled?
Comment 5 | author: citizenmatt | association: MEMBER | reactions: 4 | score: 16 | url: https://github.com/JetBrains/resharper-unity/issues/328#issuecomment-359400765
Just to confirm, we can reproduce this and it is an issue with VSTU integration. The issue happens with VSTU projects, with or without the ReSharper Unity plugin installed, which means it needs a fix in ReSharper, not this plugin. We've also got a ReSharper issue to track this: [RSRP-467875](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/RSRP-467875)
Thanks in the help with diagnosing that it's to do with VSTU projects!
Comment 6 | author: citizenmatt | association: MEMBER | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/JetBrains/resharper-unity/issues/328#issuecomment-418041544
This is actually an issue with Visual Studio Tools for Unity, and has been fixed in VSTU 3.8.0.6, which is part of Visual Studio 2017 15.8.2, and can be [downloaded for Visual Studio 2015](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SebastienLebreton.VisualStudio2015ToolsforUnity).

<!-- source=github_issue; title=Can't Run Convergence; url=https://github.com/worldofbalance/unity-game-client/issues/16 -->

# Can't Run Convergence

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/worldofbalance/unity-game-client/issues/16

Hey I cant seem to run convergence, i have the server up and running and i changed the config file on the client side and they are communicating but I get a blue screen whenever I enter the convergence game. Anybody else having this issue?
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: dlhoff | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/worldofbalance/unity-game-client/issues/16#issuecomment-204729204
Copied from iLearn post as Jens requested. Everyone can also see all items on iLearn:
I wanted to get both the client and server running locally to have an environment for development.
I did a git clone of the unity-game-client and lobby-server. [I understand that the Convergence
server is inside the lobby-server.] I ran the unity-game-client and it connects to remote server
and works. I could login. First, i wanted to change the unity-game-client to communicate over
localhost. In Assets/Scripts/Config.cs, i changed REMOTE_HOST to "localhost".
This seemed to be the only change necessary.
After that I ran the unity-game-client and it tried to communicate on localhost.
Since i did not have the lobby-server running, it was not able to make a connection.
This way i verified that it was trying on localhost.
I ran the lobby_server in Netbeans and it could not open the wob.sql file. I tried a bunch of things
and could not get the local copy of wob.sql to work. I decided at this point it was ok in the
development process to use the remote database on smurf. So, i changed file conf/db.conf to use
these credentials:
DBURL smurf.sfsu.edu
DBName wob
DBUsername wob
DBPassword asd123
This solved the database problem. I was accessing the smurf database.
I had problems with the class MiniGameServers. In the initMiniGames() method it tries to queue up
Running Rhino and Cards of the Wild using jar files to start those mini games. The problem is that i could not find these jar
files in the paths indicated. So, when the server starts up, it gives error messages. I commented
out the block of code below:
```
game = new MiniGame("Running Rhino");
game.setAsMultiPlayerGame("../Speed_Server/dist/Speed_Server.jar", 20039);
miniGames.put(game.getName(), game);
game = new MiniGame("Cards of the Wild");
game.setAsMultiPlayerGame("../WoC_Server/dist/Cards_Server.jar", 20038);
miniGames.put(game.getName(), game);
```
After that, the server started up without any error messages.
I ran the unity-game-client and they made a connection. I was able to Register a new user/password
and login. Also, i was able to run the Convergence game. It worked well. With the remote server, only
about 20% of the time for me would a change in graph appear after pressing the Submit button. However,
with the local server, it works about every time. Also, the Netbeans console shows that ecosystem
information is being retrieved.
I think the atn simulator is still running remotely which is ok for now.
There are a few things to work on:
1. Errors messages occur for database problems. Like:
Column 'atn_manipulation_id' not found.
SQL exception: Unknown column 'csv_atn' in 'field list', cause: null
2. The Unity console said several times that connection failed and reconnecting. Yet, the login
still worked. I did not see this problem on the project 1 server work.
Comment 2 | author: dlhoff | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/worldofbalance/unity-game-client/issues/16#issuecomment-204759114
Did you check the NetBeans console log? It may show an error message.
Also, you can pause the Client and check its log. The Client log shows all of the request messages sent to the Server and the response received from the Server. For each request, there normally is a response. There may be a request sent and no response received. Then, on the NetBeans console there may be a message that helps understand the problem.
Do you start the Server first and wait until you see the message "> Now accepting connections..." before starting the Client? I always wait for this message before starting the Clients.
Perhaps the problem is Server credentials. Here are all my Server credential file names and their values:
db local.conf:
#Database URL
DBURL localhost
#Database name
DBName WOB
#Database user name
DBUsername root
#Database user password
DBPassword root
db.conf:
#Database URL
DBURL localhost
#Database name
#DBName csc63101
DBName wob
#Database user name
DBUsername root
#Database user password
DBPassword newpwd
db.conf local:
#Database URL
DBURL localhost
#Database name
DBName WOB_DB
#Database user name
DBUsername root
#Database user password
DBPassword root
You can use the debugger to step through the Server operation on NetBeans or the other thing i do in these situations is add a lot of console print messages in the form of:
NetBeans:
Log.println("message, value x = " + x);
Unity/C#:
Debug.Log ("message, value x = " + x);
I scatter these about to isolate where the problem is and then drill down on it.

# bannerview.hide () doesn't work.

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/googleads/googleads-mobile-unity/issues/74

hi,
i'm using the admob plugin for unity 4.6, i've implemented the banner and in game it is shown.
i have written
**void YYYYY
if(Show == false)
bannerview.hide();
else
bannerview.show();
void XXXXX
if(application.loadedlevelname == XXXX)
show = false;**
when i run the project on pc when i load the XXXX scene in the debug console appear "Dummy HideBannerView" but when i run the app on my phone the banner doesn't hide.
any ideas?
thanks
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: rampara | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/googleads/googleads-mobile-unity/issues/74#issuecomment-76280833
The "Dummy HideBannerView" debug message only appears when running the Unity application through the editor. Since there is no ads SDK available for the editor a dummy client is used with no actual functionality. The show() and hide() commands should work correctly when run on a phone. Can you see a "Calling hide() on Android" message in logcat?
- Ram
Comment 2 | author: rampara | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/googleads/googleads-mobile-unity/issues/74#issuecomment-76473543
Follow the instructions at http://developer.android.com/tools/device.html to ensure your device is correctly set up for adb debugging. When you run the adb devices command you should see your device listed. Once your device is listed run the following command
Adb logcat GoogleMobileAdsUnityPlugin:\* *:S
Whenever you hide or show a banner you should see a corresponding output in logcat.
- Ram
Comment 3 | author: pumpkinotto | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/googleads/googleads-mobile-unity/issues/74#issuecomment-76483111

any ideas?

ps
sorry for the bad english
Comment 4 | author: rampara | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/googleads/googleads-mobile-unity/issues/74#issuecomment-76488166
You can refer to the documentation at http://docs.unity3d.com/412/Documentation/ScriptReference/index.Accessing_Other_Game_Objects.html. You can also hide the ad in OnDisable() which is called during a scene change .
- Ram
Comment 5 | author: rampara | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/googleads/googleads-mobile-unity/issues/74#issuecomment-76673849
You would need to follow the instructions in the link I gave in my previous comment to access variables from another script. OnDisable() does have a return type of void and it is called on game objects during a change of scene. You can try hiding the ad in the OnDisable() method for your main camera in the first scene.
- Ram

I found the issue and can fix. Unity finally fixed a typo in their Editor UI, which now broke the EntityDrawer (typo was 'Seach' instead of 'Search')
old:
```csharp
public static GUIStyle ToolbarSearchTextField =>
_toolbarSearchTextField ??= GUI.skin.FindStyle("ToolbarSeachTextField");
public static GUIStyle ToolbarSearchCancelButtonStyle =>
_toolbarSearchCancelButtonStyle ??= GUI.skin.FindStyle("ToolbarSeachCancelButton");
```
new:
```csharp
public static GUIStyle ToolbarSearchTextField =>
_toolbarSearchTextField ??= GUI.skin.FindStyle("ToolbarSearchTextField");
public static GUIStyle ToolbarSearchCancelButtonStyle =>
_toolbarSearchCancelButtonStyle ??= GUI.skin.FindStyle("ToolbarSearchCancelButton");
```

# [Bug]: Unity 6000.3.0f crash due to missing method (Unity v6000.3 with BIE 5)

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/yukieiji/UnityExplorer/issues/81

### Are you on the latest version of UnityExplorer?
- [x] Yes, I'm on the latest version of UnityExplorer.
### Will other mods work? (Not mods that change settings, but small mods that access game objects, etc.)
- [x] Yes, work fine!!
### Which release are you using?
BepInEx 5.X Mono
### Which game did this occur on?
The Planet Crafter, Unity 6000.3.0f1
### Does this game support mods?
- [x] Yes support!!
### Describe the issue.
The game `The Planet Crafter` got a preview update to Unity 6000.3.0f. This and the original UnityExplorer now crash on startup due to missing method.
Last Unity version this worked was with 6000.0.x.
### Relevant log output

Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: yukieiji | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/yukieiji/UnityExplorer/issues/81#issuecomment-3670744748
The following Unity core code appears to assume that `GetNameInternal` takes an `int` as its argument.
https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/UnityCsReference/blob/master/Runtime/Export/SceneManager/Scene.cs
Therefore, it appears to be a bug when decompiling code in Mono.
It should work with BIE6.
Comment 2 | author: yukieiji | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/yukieiji/UnityExplorer/issues/81#issuecomment-3853318721
This isn't a case of it not being fixed, but rather a `reflection` issue where exceptions are not being properly caught. it's a separate issue from this issue.
Comment 3 | author: yukieiji | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/yukieiji/UnityExplorer/issues/81#issuecomment-3853464650
> This isn't a case of it not being fixed, but rather a reflection issue where exceptions are not being properly caught. it's a separate issue from this issue.
This was a bug in UniverseLib, so we fixed it and released it as [v4.13.1](https://github.com/yukieiji/UnityExplorer/releases/tag/v4.13.1).
Comment 4 | author: yukieiji | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/yukieiji/UnityExplorer/issues/81#issuecomment-3853729002
You should properly review the bug fixes made in v4.13.0.
A fallback for `GetNameInternal` is currently implemented. This is a separate bug where errors are not being caught and the fallback isn't working, probably due to an issue with the internal processing system such as UniverseLib.
Therefore, the `GetNameInternal` bug is no longer relevant at all.
Comment 5 | author: yukieiji | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/yukieiji/UnityExplorer/issues/81#issuecomment-3854044403
> Scene.GetNameInternal: System.ArgumentException: Object of type 'System.Int32' cannot be converted to type 'UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneHandle'.
Even though the following conversion method exists, the above error appears, which is strange.
Conversion is failing for convertible types, doesn't this indicate a runtime issue?
```cs
// Token: 0x06002AC6 RID: 10950 RVA: 0x00015DA7 File Offset: 0x00013FA7
public static implicit operator SceneHandle(int handle)
{
return SceneHandle.From(handle);
}
```
> What works is compiling the unchanged sources against UE 6.3.
This is a waste of effort that only provides a temporary solution and incurs a lot of technical debt and support costs.
> You'd basically need to emulate all the internal changes from UE 6.3 on a fully reflective basis otherwise.
I've said many times that it's a runtime bug.
Comment 6 | author: yukieiji | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/yukieiji/UnityExplorer/issues/81#issuecomment-3854317368
> It's the failure of UnityExplorer to realize that accessing private internals, which were not meant to be accessed publicly, can cause problems if those internals change in subsequent versions.
So I fixed the error in "GetNameInternal," which is an internal private access, and that part has actually been fixed.
Here's a log of it running:
- [Warning:UnityExplorer] Falling back to checking loaded scenes for DontDestroyOnLoad via SceneManager.GetAllScenes(). This uses a deprecated API.
Your log say error occurring even with the [external API](https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/UnityCsReference/blob/59b03b8a0f179c0b7e038178c90b6c80b340aa9f/Runtime/Export/SceneManager/Scene.cs#L26).

<!-- source=github_issue; title=[CLIENT SIDE] NREs when loading craft around non-existent bodies; url=https://github.com/LunaMultiplayer/LunaMultiplayer/issues/588 -->

# [CLIENT SIDE] NREs when loading craft around non-existent bodies

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/LunaMultiplayer/LunaMultiplayer/issues/588

Every public server that I've connected to (there's 2 of them, 1 in my own region, 1 in another region) has had an issue where the server spams my logs with NREs, causing extreme lag. It only seems to happen in the VAB, but I haven't tried anything other than the KSC facility and the Tracking Station, so it's possible that it occurs in other buildings too. (most likely the SPH)
The errors are a warning followed by a EXC. No idea what EXC means.
The warning says that an Asteroid crashed into Kerbin's surface, like this one:
```[WRN 18:22:04.317] [F: 189694]: Vessel Ast. MLJ-333 crashed through terrain on Kerbin.```
Possibly related, there are no asteroids (tracked or untracked) in the tracking station. At all.
This is the EXC. It's a "Object reference not set to an instance of an object" error, which I have only ever seen in Unity games. I believe the only thing that changes between this error is the time at which it occurs, though it might still differ between servers.
```
[EXC 18:22:04.317] NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
Vessel.GetVesselCrew () (at <4b449f2841f84227adfaad3149c8fdba>:0)
Vessel.MurderCrew () (at <4b449f2841f84227adfaad3149c8fdba>:0)
(wrapper dynamic-method) Vessel.Vessel.CheckKill_Patch1(Vessel)
VesselPrecalculate.MainPhysics (System.Boolean doKillChecks) (at <4b449f2841f84227adfaad3149c8fdba>:0)
VesselPrecalculate.FixedUpdate () (at <4b449f2841f84227adfaad3149c8fdba>:0)
```
I have never seen this on my own private servers, but those have never ran for long times like public ones sometimes do. Even opening the log is laggy, almost crashing my code editor. (which I use as a text editor as well)
This may also be a more detailed explanation for the lag and freezing described in #572 and #580 respectively.
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: BraveCaperCat2 | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 5 | url: https://github.com/LunaMultiplayer/LunaMultiplayer/issues/588#issuecomment-3705944362
231 days later and I've managed to locate the source of this issue - it happens because of some crafts having an invalid reference body property. I believe this can be caused by loading into a server with a planet pack, putting a vessel into the SOI of an object added by that planet pack and then loading into that server without the planet pack. It can be temporarily fixed by deleting the offending vessels and is likely permanently fixed by blocking people with the mod "Kopernicus" (a library for planet packs) from joining the server.
Comment 2 | author: ErrinDev | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 5 | url: https://github.com/LunaMultiplayer/LunaMultiplayer/issues/588#issuecomment-3757325318
Since this was linked to an issue I commented on, I'll clarify that at the time I experienced the lag issue, the server had been running for around 3-4 hours, and it was a private server, in which we both used the same mods.
Comment 3 | author: Fierce-Cat | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 5 | url: https://github.com/LunaMultiplayer/LunaMultiplayer/issues/588#issuecomment-3757398033
I've partially fixed this issue with this [PR](https://github.com/Fierce-Cat/LunaMultiPlayer/pull/1) to my public fork, although I'm still investigating the memory leak. It's safe to use the pre-release version on [this page](https://github.com/Fierce-Cat/LunaMultiPlayer/releases/tag/0.29.1) or for server using the [docker image](https://github.com/Fierce-Cat/LunaMultiPlayer/pkgs/container/lunamultiplayer%2Fserver/588378949?tag=0.29.1), as long as you do restart the server every few days. I'll be submitting a PR to the main repository soon.
And the other part of the problem, where some players were entering the server with a planet pack, simply enable the plugin mod control could solve it.

# Is mapbox-unity abandonware ?

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-unity-sdk/issues/1837

No new releases since octobrer 2019, no news in the official mapbox wepage, it doenst have any mention in mapbox mails newsletter with new features where appear mapbox for js and other platforms.
Seems abandoned...no bugfixes releases, no new features in two years...Can anyone confirm this ?
Thanks
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: DevNMY | association: NONE | reactions: 4 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-unity-sdk/issues/1837#issuecomment-1011241648
bad news: everything you say is true ^^
good news: besides the silence there is some really cool work in progress. check out this non released branch https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-unity-sdk/issues/1671
We are using this branch in production as it seems to be more production ready as the official stable release from 2019. The performance of tile-loading improved massively which was the biggest pain-point for us.
but anyways it would be interesting to know whats the roadmap/timeline for unity-mapbox in the year 2022
@brnkhy maybe you could give us an update (?) :-)
Comment 2 | author: brnkhy | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 4 | score: 14 | url: https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-unity-sdk/issues/1837#issuecomment-1014647730
It's difficult for me to answer these kind of questions (Mapbox support might be a better option) but I'm actively working on Mapbox Unity SDK.
I'm focusing on the experimental performance work at the moment but I can't really suggest anyone using it for a product right now, I mean without knowing your needs and use cases etc. That's mainly because it's incomplete at the moment (doesn't really support vector layer) and branch isn't really well organized. It's really heavily WIP, for example I'm working on a system to replace whole `AbstractMap` class at the moment. (`quadTreeMap` branch @jaidhyani mentioned above but I think it should be a broken branch so don't even bother)
So shortly,
- we are actively working on it.
- performance branch is there but it's an experimental and work-in-progress thing at the moment. I really don't want to be promoting that branch/work at all (yet).
Comment 3 | author: davide-aldegheri | association: NONE | reactions: 4 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-unity-sdk/issues/1837#issuecomment-1042876858
Hi @brnkhy, thanks for all your hard work on this version of the sdk, some quick questions:
- How much of the original project is missing? I've noticed you said that if we want vector we should stick with v2.1.1 is it because you removed the ability to query vector data?
- Is it still possible to change image layer with a custom one?
- How can I work with the AbstractMap component? I've tried adding it to a GameObject but it breaks in the serialization of properties
Thanks in advance!
Comment 4 | author: Markovicho | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-unity-sdk/issues/1837#issuecomment-1066565115
> Thanks, if it's all things that can be done in a week or so then we might take a look at merging in performance branch and just see how it goes. We've made our own SDK modifications to work better for our use case, but we're still only using images and building layers. Performance branch still supports layers correct?
Building layers are still functionally included from what we can investigate in latest commit of performance branch. Refer to "ModeSwitchScene" in the examples. You may need to fix the materialmodifier lacking references to the building materials (top and bottom).

# Can't figure out how to edit WhateverDevs.TwoDAudio.Runtime.asmdef to remove broken item

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/varguiniano/YAPU/issues/3

I am trying to follow the Getting Started instructions but the lack of pictures of what things look like or should look like is making me very confused. Also doesn't help I am new to Unity.
In the Unity inspector I cannot change anything in that file as everything is all grayed out. Clicking + does nothing same for -.
Am I supposed to edit the file in Unity or an external program?
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: varguiniano | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/varguiniano/YAPU/issues/3#issuecomment-3421035636
Hi ccfman,
I completely agree that the documentation is lacking and I plan to update it along with a new version of the framework as soon as life allows me some free time.
The 2daudio package is included in the Packages - AfterPlugins folder, so it should be editable if you have renamed this folder and used it as the Packages folder.
I know the project setup is incredibly cumbersome and I apologize for it. It would be way easier if copyright laws didn't exist.
That said, while you don't need to know how to code to use YAPU, it uses a lot of advanced Unity features and concepts, so I wouldn't recommend it as a starting point. I highly recommend that you do some tutorials and check out simpler projects before tackling YAPU.
Comment 2 | author: varguiniano | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/varguiniano/YAPU/issues/3#issuecomment-3425254413
Thank you for the heads app on the vulnerability. I'm aware of it and it will be updated on the next YAPU version.
I'd have to check the installer checklist. I think it looked for a precompiler variable that DoTweem adds, maybe they've changed the name of the variable.
I'm aware of the null pointer when scrolling fast through a large list but I haven't seen any case where it's game breaking, so I haven't looked at it yet. Did it break the UI you were on?
I've tried a Mac build once and it worked, but it was on a friend's computer since I don't own a Mac and it's not something I can do regularly. I've also tested it sporadically on Linux (Steam Deck) and Android and made sure it works, but it's not something I've bothered too much with at this stage of development. I'm looking at implementing multiplayer as the next milestone, so I guess I'm going to test at least the Linux build a lot more from now.

From what I can see the error is in ResolutionSelector.UpdateOptions, which is a ui selector for the resolution. My guess is that it's receiving an empty list of available resolutions for your screen (if in build) or game window (if in editor). To be clear, this shouldn't break the entire game, but I missed this case. Are you running the game in the editor? If so, what resolution are you running the game view on? If it's on free aspect, can you change it to 1920x1080 and try again?

Comment 6 | author: varguiniano | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/varguiniano/YAPU/issues/3#issuecomment-3449670739
Sorry, I didn't see the previous message.
The error you are getting is an asset with a missing reference and shouldn't happen if this is a fresh project setup and you haven't changed any asset. You mentioned opening the project with a newer version of Unity and then going back. It's likely that that has messed up asset GUIDs and broken a bunch of references throughout the project. I'll try to test this when I get home but I'd suggest starting from scratch.
And yes, you only need the Inspector part of Odin. In fact enabling the serializer will break the serialization of some assets (which might be related to the previous issue). When going through the setup you should have been prompted to disable Odin Serializer automatically when packages are imported.

<!-- source=github_issue; title=NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object; url=https://github.com/srcnalt/OpenAI-Unity/issues/3 -->

# NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/srcnalt/OpenAI-Unity/issues/3

I followed all the steps but when I push the button to send the text I always receive this error message:
NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
OpenAI.ChatGPT.SendReply () (at Assets/Samples/OpenAI Unity/0.1.0/ChatGPT/ChatGPT.cs:41)
I have checked all the rederences in the editor ( the ChatGPT publics ) and all are correct.
I'm using Unity 2021.3.0f1 on a Mac.
Any help is welcome. Thanks!
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: srcnalt | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/srcnalt/OpenAI-Unity/issues/3#issuecomment-1382894757
Hi @jalemanyf,
The line mentioned in the error message is `textArea.text = completionResponse.Choices[0].Text;`
In this case, either the `textArea` field is not set in the `ChatGPT` component, or the `Choices` array is empty. In the latter case, OpenAI did not send an empty response, which I never faced. So I suppose it's that the UI reference is missing.
Comment 2 | author: srcnalt | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/srcnalt/OpenAI-Unity/issues/3#issuecomment-1383152422
Hi @jalemanyf,
I do not have error messaging covered in the requests just yet, all the fields of the response null means it could not cast the JSON correctly, which most probably was the error message. I'll create a task for that so I get that covered, in any case, a response error comes from OpenAI I can give this info to the user.
You can debug the DispatchRequest method to see the actual JSON you receive.
Comment 3 | author: srcnalt | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 9 | url: https://github.com/srcnalt/OpenAI-Unity/issues/3#issuecomment-1396905229
Hi @brunno0204 @COSMYIN90 I just realized the issue is happening during JSON parsing in the `Configuration.cs` script. Which means something with the `auth.json` might be wrong. Could you check your `/.openai/auth.json` file to if it is a valid JSON?
Comment 4 | author: srcnalt | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 8 | url: https://github.com/srcnalt/OpenAI-Unity/issues/3#issuecomment-1397282387
@brunno0204 It has to be called `api_key` instead of `private_api_key` or any other word. You might as well keep the API key in your source code, but this poses danger.
Comment 5 | author: srcnalt | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 9 | url: https://github.com/srcnalt/OpenAI-Unity/issues/3#issuecomment-1397766292
Hi @brunno0204, WebGL app cannot read your local files such auth.json
This project is not intended for production use, it might pose issues if your API key is compromised.
Comment 6 | author: srcnalt | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 9 | url: https://github.com/srcnalt/OpenAI-Unity/issues/3#issuecomment-1397788866
auth.json file check, json to data object field name mapping, and api_key as a required field brought in #6, closing the issue.

Comment 1 | author: airar-dev | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/airar-dev/Unity-AR-ColorMapping/issues/29#issuecomment-1313261047
Does the issue occur if you build with Android or iOS?
(This library does not work in the Unity editor. It only works on Android or iOS platforms.)
If this error occurs on Android,
Please make sure that the libopencv_java3.so file is also included in the
project.
And set the cpu of the libAirarColorMap.so file and libopencv_java3.so file
included in the project to 64-bit.
Or, in case of iOS, the project must include the libAirarColorMap.a file and the opencv2.framework file.

# Possible to consider adding the ability to query/add members from within SubScenes which are loaded for editing?

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/com.unity.selection-groups/issues/75

Hey again,
I didn't expect it to work, but I wanted to give it a try anyways. Of course, the result was that it didn't work, but I was wondering what the likelihood would be of supporting the ability to query/add members from within open SubScenes?
Ex.
![](https://i.imgur.com/smZChlF.png)
Thanks,
-MH
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: sindharta | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/com.unity.selection-groups/issues/75#issuecomment-930678478
We put in a small fix to address this, but perhaps the fix addressed a different issue, and we didn't fully understand the bug that you brought up.
Could you please attach a small project that we can open to reproduce this ?
Comment 2 | author: MostHated | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/com.unity.selection-groups/issues/75#issuecomment-930690117
Oh, sorry, it's not a bug I don't believe, more of a feature request. The items in the hierarchy (Section_1 - 4) are GameObjects within a subscene (each has a component on it of type SubSceneDetailsComponentAuthoring).
As it stands, queries don't seem to be able to access subscenes hierarchy to return those GameObjects, which I did not expect it to be able to, as in order to reference those objects myself now, I have to use something along the lines of this:
```cs
SubScene subScene;
...
if (!subScene.EditingScene.isLoaded) return;
var rootGameObjects = subScene.GetRootGameObjects();
for (int i = 0; i < rootGameObjects.Length; i++)
{
// Do whatever
}
```
I was merely wondering if it were possible to extend the reach of the queries to be able to traverse the subscene hierarchy as well.
Comment 3 | author: smnwttbr | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/com.unity.selection-groups/issues/75#issuecomment-930780069
I believe if the selection group scope is set to 'Editor', it will be able to reference objects across all loaded scenes.

Btw, SelectionGroups in version `0.5.5-preview` can contain GameObject in subscenes.
But if you unload the subscene, then it will be deleted.

# Socket Disconnetcts when trying to create party

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/heroiclabs/nakama-unity/issues/119

Hello Guys. As i always say, thank you for your excellent work with Nakama. Recently you solved a big problem with Unity WebGl and that helped me a lot. Now im facing another issue, when i try to create a party the socket disconnects automatically, i dont know why. This is my test code, is taken from original Nakama Example:
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using Nakama;
using System;
public class Test : MonoBehaviour
{
private const string SessionTokenKey = "nksession";
private const string UdidKey = "udid";
private IClient _client;
private ISocket _socket;
private ISocket _socket2;
public string serverText;
public string serverPortText;
public async void Awake()
{
try
{
const string scheme = "http";
string host = serverText;
int port = Int32.Parse(serverPortText);
const string serverKey = "defaultkey";
_client = new Client(scheme, host, port, serverKey, UnityWebRequestAdapter.Instance);
_socket = _client.NewSocket();
_socket.Closed += () => Debug.Log("Socket closed.");
_socket.Connected += () => Debug.Log("Socket connected.");
_socket.ReceivedError += e => Debug.Log("Socket error: " + e.Message);
_socket.ReceivedParty += e => print(e.Leader);
_socket.ReceivedPartyData += e => print(e.Data);
_socket.ReceivedPartyClose += e => print(e.ToString());
// Cant use SystemInfo.deviceUniqueIdentifier with WebGL builds.
var udid = PlayerPrefs.GetString(UdidKey, Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
Debug.Log("Unique Device ID: " + udid);
ISession session;
var sessionToken = PlayerPrefs.GetString(SessionTokenKey);
if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sessionToken) || (session = Session.Restore(sessionToken)).IsExpired)
{
session = await _client.AuthenticateDeviceAsync(udid);
PlayerPrefs.SetString(UdidKey, udid);
PlayerPrefs.SetString(SessionTokenKey, session.AuthToken);
}
Debug.Log("Session Token: " + session.AuthToken);
await _socket.ConnectAsync(session, true);
await _socket2.ConnectAsync(session, true);
Debug.Log("Connected ");
UnityMainThreadDispatcher.Instance().Enqueue(JoinParty());
//var party = await _socket.CreatePartyAsync(open: true, maxSize: 10);
//Debug.Log("New Party: " + party.ToString());
var match = await _socket.CreateMatchAsync();
Debug.Log("Created match: " + match.Id);
//await _socket.CloseAsync();
}
catch (Exception e)
{
Debug.LogError(e.ToString());
}
}
private void OnApplicationQuit()
{
_socket?.CloseAsync();
}
public IEnumerator JoinParty()
{
var party = _socket.CreatePartyAsync(true, maxSize: 10);
Debug.Log(party.Id);;
yield return null;
}
}
I tried first using directly the await "var party = await _socket.CreatePartyAsync(open: true, maxSize: 10);" but unity was showing a main threading problem. I searched on forums and found that we can use this asset:
https://github.com/PimDeWitte/UnityMainThreadDispatcher
So i moved the command into a IEnumerator. And is dosconnecting too. This is a screenshot of de debug console:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/62043866/130106426-019b444b-ac18-40fc-9422-1bb565f9553b.png)
At the end i will use it into a webgl project, but is not even running on Unity Editor. Please Help me!
Im using the new vwesion of Nakama V3.1.1, Unity 2020.2.2 (tried with 2021.1.15 with same result) and Using nakama with Digital Ocean.

Hey @champilas. First off, there is no need to use `UnityMainThreadDispatcher` or `IEnumerator.` What you are reading on the forum is outdated information.
Second, why are you opening multiple sockets with the same session? Could you rewrite your example with only one socket and without the main thread dispatcher and IEnumerator?

# No Video Stream on MacOS (or Errors)

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/UnityRenderStreaming/issues/271

Running this on MacOS. To reproduce:
- Have opened the `SimpleScene`.
- Ran the WebApp and navigated to `localhost`, where the web interface loads with the "play" icon as expected.
- Run the Unity Scene
- Click the "Play" icon in Google Chrome (Version 80.0.3987.132 (Official Build) (64-bit))
- Connection established (Browser Console logs as follows):
```
pc.iceConnectionState:connected
video-player.js:113 Datachannel connected.
```
- No errors reported in either Unity or Browser, but no video stream appears.
- I can however click the buttons in the browser to control the lighting inside the Unity Environment.

# Batcher.cs Exception

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/ml-agents/issues/2391

**Describe the bug**
NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
MLAgents.Batcher.SendAcademyParameters (MLAgents.CommunicatorObjects.UnityRLInitializationOutput academyParameters) (at Assets/ML-Agents/Scripts/Batcher.cs:96)
MLAgents.Academy.InitializeEnvironment () (at Assets/ML-Agents/Scripts/Academy.cs:345)
MLAgents.Academy.Awake () (at Assets/ML-Agents/Scripts/Academy.cs:250)
**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. I use public override void InitializeAcademy() method in my academy
2. when I click "run", I got the above Exception
I walk through the Batcher.CS source code, and find there might be a code error:
start from line 75:
public CommunicatorObjects.UnityRLInitializationInput SendAcademyParameters(
CommunicatorObjects.UnityRLInitializationOutput academyParameters)
{
CommunicatorObjects.UnityInput input;
var initializationInput = new CommunicatorObjects.UnityInput();
try
{
initializationInput = m_communicator.Initialize(
new CommunicatorObjects.UnityOutput
{
RlInitializationOutput = academyParameters
},
out input);
}
catch
{
throw new UnityAgentsException(
"The Communicator was unable to connect. Please make sure the External " +
"process is ready to accept communication with Unity.");
}
var firstRlInput = input.RlInput;
here we can see 'input' is not an instance.
I think that's why I got the Exception.
**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.
**Environment (please complete the following information):**
- Windows 10
- _ML-Agents version_:0.9
- _Environment_: 0.9
**NOTE:** We are unable to help reproduce bugs with custom environments. Please attempt to reproduce your issue with one of the example environments, or provide a minimal patch to one of the environments needed to reproduce the issue.
Selected solution comments:

# UIWidgets 性能问题

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/UnityTech/UIWidgets/issues/406

TL; DR：**当前的 UIWidgets 代码仓库是否存在性能问题？如果是的话，未来大概什么时候会优化？**
最近尝试学习 UIWidgets，发现自己写的示例 app 即使非常简单，也会有非常肉眼可见的性能问题，比如说：
1）用 PageView 切换页面时很卡
2）Switch Widgets 的动画很卡
用 graphy 看了看，确实在上述两种场景下 fps 会掉得特别厉害
由于在 Editor 上能流畅运行，一开始觉得是自己测试机性能太差，但【**ConnectApp**】是能流畅运行的，所以怀疑是实现的问题
上网查了查，用上了一些常用的小优化，问题没有得到解决
后面把官方的【**Gallery**】打包下来试了试，发现【**性能问题更加严重**】，所以又怀疑是这边的 UIWidgets 并不是最新版、又或是直接用 unity 打包本身会存在性能问题
看了看 issue，有提到动态 fps，有提到未来会把 ConnectApp 那边的功能迁移过来，所以我这边也不好判断到底是我写拐了还是说当前的 UIWidgets 尚未成熟
所以就回到抬头的问题了：**当前的 UIWidgets 代码仓库是否存在性能问题？如果是的话，未来大概什么时候会优化？**

# InputSystemDisable() followed by InputSystem.Enable causes NullPointerExceptions

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityToolkit-Unity/issues/5085

## Overview
Disabling and then re-enabling the input system causes the following exception to be thrown every frame:
```
NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
Microsoft.MixedReality.Toolkit.Input.FocusProvider.RegisterPointers (Microsoft.MixedReality.Toolkit.Input.IMixedRealityInputSource inputSource) (at Assets/MixedRealityToolkit.Services/InputSystem/FocusProvider.cs:689)
````
## Steps to reproduce
Use the following script to enable and disable the input system. Notice that after enabling the input system console spits out continuous null pointers:
```
using Microsoft.MixedReality.Toolkit;
using Microsoft.MixedReality.Toolkit.Input;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
public class DisableInputSystemTest : MonoBehaviour
{
private IMixedRealityInputSystem inputSystem = null;
private IMixedRealityInputSystem InputSystem
{
get
{
if (inputSystem == null)
{
MixedRealityServiceRegistry.TryGetService<IMixedRealityInputSystem>(out inputSystem);
}
return inputSystem;
}
}
public void DisableInputSystem()
{
InputSystem.Disable();
}
public void EnableInputSystem()
{
InputSystem.Enable();
}
public void Update()
{
if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha1))
{
EnableInputSystem();
}
if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha2))
{
DisableInputSystem();
}
}
}
```
## Unity Editor Version
2018.4.1f1
## Mixed Reality Toolkit Release Version
mrtk_development latest

Comment 3 | author: wiwei | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityToolkit-Unity/issues/5085#issuecomment-525867091
Alrighty, I spent some time here looking into what's going on, and it's interesting. Basically, the input system as a whole is larger than just MixedRealityInputSystem.Enable/Disable - the system has dependencies on other services that are for some reason independent (i.e. the FocusProvider - it's another top level service instead of a sub-service of the MixedRealityInputSystem, and then GazeProvider - this is actually a MonoBehaviour, whose lifetime is managed totally separately from the MRTK main runtime).
What happens when you run Enable() is that the gaze provider never actually gets re-initialized with the input system, so you end up seeing streams of exceptions that come through. This is because Enable() (and disable!) only actually touch the input system itself, and not the gaze provider.
Talking with some other folks, I don't think that input system's enable and disable functions were ever really meant to be invoked directly - i.e. they are public because they need to be public in order for the MRTK runtime to call them.
This is complicated more by the fact that it's possible to have multiple scenes/MRTK objects (i.e. multiple MRTK objects, only one of which is active). Having folks manually control the state of underlying MRTK services will actually put the MRTK itself into a weird state, because then later when the active instance changes, for example, the same services will then just be re-enabled (instead of kept disabled, if there was a previous call to disable it).
I think that there's value in being able to disable specific systems at runtime, and recognizing those things called out above, I think that it probably makes sense to:
1. Document that the IMixedRealityService functions aren't meant to be called except by the MRTK runtime itself.
1. Update the IMixedRealityServiceRegistrar to have an EnableService and DisableService function, which will properly enable/disable the corresponding services (for example, in the input system case, it will also disable/enable the focus provider gaze provider)
1. Add a helper to CoreServices to also have this EnableService/DisableService to help with familiarity for folks who are already using the CoreServices helper.
Comment 4 | author: gilbdev | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 2 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityToolkit-Unity/issues/5085#issuecomment-526085996
on a longer term :
if you want users to avoid accessing some functions, you may go with internal interfaces.
http://www.csharp411.com/c-internal-interface/
together with [InternalsVisibleToAttribute](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.runtime.compilerservices.internalsvisibletoattribute) to be able to have internal calls cross-mrtk-assemblies
```
internal interface IMixedRealityServiceInternal
{
void MyInternalMethod();
}
public class MyService :
IMixedRealityService, IMixedRealityServiceInternal
{
public void MyPublicMethod() { }
void IMixedRealityServiceInternal.MyInternalMethod()
{
}
}
```
the only tricky thing is you have to cast (or store) the MyService to IMixedRealityServiceInternal to be able to call the internal function or use [some extensions tricks](https://alexfranchuk.com/blog/internal-interface-classes-in-csharp/)
this may be a lot of refactor but will clearly show what can be called from the public interface to users :)

> Update the IMixedRealityServiceRegistrar to have an EnableService and DisableService function, which will properly enable/disable the corresponding services (for example, in the input system case, it will also disable/enable the focus provider gaze provider)
> Add a helper to CoreServices to also have this EnableService/DisableService to help with familiarity for folks who are already using the CoreServices helper.
> Move the registration and management of the focusprovider (and related services) inside of the input system.
These make sense to me.
> I am not 100% certain why focusprovider is considered a core system, though i can imagine scenarios where it would be handy to be separate from the input system.
I also don't see why. I guess that Stephen H. the original architect could maybe explain why he made FocusProvider a core system? I would think that FocusProvider is just an internal part of the input system. I don't really see how focus provider could be used independently of the input system. Seems like we should probably remove it, though that's probably not as important as issues right now (fixing functionality, adding documentation).

<!-- source=github_issue; title=What kind model do you use in your example?; url=https://github.com/Syn-McJ/TFClassify-Unity/issues/6 -->

# What kind model do you use in your example?

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/Syn-McJ/TFClassify-Unity/issues/6

Hi, could you tell me what model do you use in your example? I replace the bytes file with pb file export from my model, but it doesn't work. Could you give me your model file or checkpoint? Thanks so much!
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: Syn-McJ | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/Syn-McJ/TFClassify-Unity/issues/6#issuecomment-375545290
I'm using inception model from official Tensorflow repo. If you clone it and build Android example, you'll have tensorflow_inception_graph.pb file [right here in assets folder](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/tree/master/tensorflow/examples/android/assets). It's not in the repository though, I assume it gets downloaded during the build, so you can explore build tools to check where it's coming from.
When you use your own model (especially if it's not inception but mobilenet or something else), you should also make sure to set correct variables in Calssifier.cs:
```
private static int INPUT_SIZE = 224;
private static int IMAGE_MEAN = 117;
private static float IMAGE_STD = 1;
private static string INPUT_NAME = "input";
private static string OUTPUT_NAME = "output";
```
Comment 2 | author: wowliuzj | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 5 | url: https://github.com/Syn-McJ/TFClassify-Unity/issues/6#issuecomment-375554663
Thank you for reply! It's still now working. I use the pb file in repo to predict in my python project, and it says KeyError: "The name 'import/input' refers to an Operation not in the graph.". Don't know if the model format is not compatible or something.
Comment 3 | author: Syn-McJ | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/Syn-McJ/TFClassify-Unity/issues/6#issuecomment-375560976
That error means that input name in this variable `private static string INPUT_NAME = "input";` isn't the same as in the trained model. You can try `"Mul" `as the other common name for input layer. If it still doesn't work, you'll have to explore your model closely to find out the name of its input layer, which is out of scope of my expertise, I'm afraid.
Comment 4 | author: Syn-McJ | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 9 | url: https://github.com/Syn-McJ/TFClassify-Unity/issues/6#issuecomment-377177713
NullReferenceException might be caused by my code, if you can attach a model for me to reproduce this issue, I'll check why it's happening.
Comment 5 | author: Syn-McJ | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/Syn-McJ/TFClassify-Unity/issues/6#issuecomment-377194449
It seems like problem might be because of mismatch between Tensorflow version you used to train this model and Tensorflow version that Unity plugin uses. What TF version you have? You can probably just do `pip list` in a terminal to see it.
Comment 6 | author: Syn-McJ | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/Syn-McJ/TFClassify-Unity/issues/6#issuecomment-377197581
Yes, it seems like this is the problem. Please downgrade TF to 1.4 and check model trained with that version.
This is part of the exception I see in adb, which gives you a hint there at the end:
`InvalidArgumentError (see above for traceback): NodeDef mentions attr 'dilations' not in Op<name=Conv2D; ... (Check whether your GraphDef-interpreting binary is up to date with your GraphDef-generating binary.).`

Comment 4 | author: kisence-mian | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/kisence-mian/MyUnityFrameWork/issues/7#issuecomment-348386695
If you want to use AssetsBundle, you need to first package your assets into AssetsBundle
the specific method is in Window->打包设置编辑器 (package settings editor) ->自动添加Resource目录下的资源并保存 (automatically add resources under the Resource directory and save) ->打包 (package)
After you update your resources, remember to re-package your AssetsBundle, If you think the whole package time is too long， you can individually package a resource
I recommend using Resource mode during development and AssetsBundle mode at release time
Comment 5 | author: kisence-mian | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/kisence-mian/MyUnityFrameWork/issues/7#issuecomment-348389324
Yes, if we use AssetsBundle mode, after the package is complete, we should delete the Resources folder, I recommend the use of the renamed method, Change Resources to _Resources,
The main difference between these two methods is that one can hot Update the resources, and the other can not, the application of the startup speed and loading speed are also different
Comment 6 | author: kisence-mian | association: OWNER | reactions: 2 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/kisence-mian/MyUnityFrameWork/issues/7#issuecomment-348846853
When you build an AssetsBundle on a PC platform, the Bundle you typed is not available on Android
You need to switch to the Android platform to package

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/Demigiant/dotween/issues/395

Heya Daniele! =B
Would be great to make it possible to use DOTween Pro from the UPM package ^^
For now it does not works - I see errors when adding DOTweenAnimation for example:
`NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
DG.DOTweenEditor.EditorUtils.SetEditorTexture (UnityEngine.Texture2D texture, UnityEngine.FilterMode filterMode, System.Int32 maxTextureSize) (at D:/DG/_Develop/__UNITY3_CLASSES/_Holoville/__DOTween/_DOTween.Assembly/DOTweenEditor/EditorUtils.cs:75)
DG.DOTweenEditor.UI.EditorGUIUtils.get_logo () (at D:/DG/_Develop/__UNITY3_CLASSES/_Holoville/__DOTween/_DOTween.Assembly/DOTweenEditor/UI/EditorGUIUtils.cs:41)
DG.DOTweenEditor.UI.EditorGUIUtils.InspectorLogo () (at D:/DG/_Develop/__UNITY3_CLASSES/_Holoville/__DOTween/_DOTween.Assembly/DOTweenEditor/UI/EditorGUIUtils.cs:124)
DG.DOTweenEditor.DOTweenAnimationInspector.OnInspectorGUI () (at Packages/com.modumlab.thirdparty.tools.dotween-pro/Demigiant/DOTweenPro/Editor/DOTweenAnimationInspector.cs:219)
UnityEditor.InspectorWindow.DoOnInspectorGUI (System.Boolean rebuildOptimizedGUIBlock, UnityEditor.Editor editor, System.Boolean wasVisible, UnityEngine.Rect& contentRect) (at C:/buildslave/unity/build/Editor/Mono/Inspector/InspectorWindow.cs:1625)
UnityEngine.GUIUtility:ProcessEvent(Int32, IntPtr)
`
And I see empty settings window with this text (no scripts compilations is in process at that moment):
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/883587/81460919-0e194f00-91b1-11ea-9496-bfbf445f5ea9.png)
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: Demigiant | association: OWNER | reactions: 4 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/Demigiant/dotween/issues/395#issuecomment-626130888
Dmitriy! :)
I know and I tried various times with different approaches, but the problem is that DOTween relies a lot on the ability to modify its files (that's how the modules work), so they can't stay inside the UPM storage, and it's complicated to implement a mixed system like that aaaand make it work also on older version of Unity :P
Comment 2 | author: DmitriyYukhanov | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 2 | score: 17 | url: https://github.com/Demigiant/dotween/issues/395#issuecomment-626210342
Ah, yeah, I totally understand this, thank you for trying anyways!
Just hope some day you'll be able to solve this, I believe you'll win this battle! \o/
But until this will happen, it would be super great to just let it work from packages as is ^^
I mean something like this:
- move settings out from the Assets folder to the Project\ProjectSettings using
`UnityEditorInternal.InternalEditorUtility.SaveToSerializedFileAndForget()
UnityEditorInternal.InternalEditorUtility.LoadSerializedFileAndForget()`
- make plugin's root path dynamic and try look for resources and such independently from current DOTween \ DOTweenPro path
- disable ability to change modules when working from packages
So it could be imported and configured as usual in Unity's Assets folder but keep working in that state while it's wrapped in package as is and used in such state from the UPM ecosystem.
Comment 3 | author: Demigiant | association: OWNER | reactions: 10 | score: 16 | url: https://github.com/Demigiant/dotween/issues/395#issuecomment-626213214
Ohhhh I didn't know those UnityEditorInteral methods, I like that!!!!
I thought of disabling module changes when using UPM, but the problem is that some modules depend on if the relative asset is present (like TextMesh Pro) so they need to be activated/deactivated. Otherwise if I keep them always deactivated there will be no TextMesh Pro shortcuts, and if I keep them always activated it will not work on projects without TextMesh Pro :|
Buuuut! I could use SaveToSerializedFileAndForget for the modules too. I will test this :)
Comment 4 | author: laicasaane | association: NONE | reactions: 2 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/Demigiant/dotween/issues/395#issuecomment-657977239
> but the problem is that some modules depend on if the relative asset is present (like TextMesh Pro) so they need to be activated/deactivated
How about the conditional compilation symbols? You could define something like DOTWEEN_TMPRO in the project rather than toggle this ```#if true // MODULE_MARKER``` in the source code
Comment 5 | author: DmitriyYukhanov | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/Demigiant/dotween/issues/395#issuecomment-723988993
> Unity a year ago brought out this 2018.4+ compatible package (I don't know if it works in older versions) that I have personally used many times in our code base and it works very well.
>
> https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.settings-manager@1.0/manual/index.html
Yeah this is nice generalized way to store settings in packages though it makes me upset they choose EditorPrefs over UserSettings folder (default one for 2020.1+) for the UserSettingsRepository (implemented own settings storage at UserSettings \ ProjectSettings in my plugins).
Comment 6 | author: hulcypdiscord | association: NONE | reactions: 8 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/Demigiant/dotween/issues/395#issuecomment-839867384
Unity also now supports conditionally defining Preprocessor Symbols based on currently installed packages like TextMeshPro:
https://docs.unity3d.com/2020.1/Documentation/Manual/ScriptCompilationAssemblyDefinitionFiles.html?_ga=2.36724064.1999471002.1620662952-1271225660.1595348587
This might help with reducing the need to modify any script files.

# Confirm Vuforia compatibility with Unity 6 LTS

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/PTCInc/vuforia-engine/issues/173

**Summarize your device feedback**
https://developer.vuforia.com/library/platform-support/supported-versions
While Unity 2022 LTS is the listed supported version, I briefly tested using the AR Camera in Unity 6, which seemed to work. I wonder however if it is fully compatible to use it Unity 6. Unity 2022 says to be supported until at least May 2025, and since I need use another unity package that is compatible with Unity 2020 (so requires code changes to make it work on 2022/Unity 6) we were thinking to stick with latest LTS release there is currently.
Anybody aware if there are currently any issues in using Vuforia on Unity 6?
So far, I tried on Unity 6 and AR Camera works.
**Describe your device**
Unity 6

Comment 4 | author: ptc-epassaro | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/PTCInc/vuforia-engine/issues/173#issuecomment-2705872400
Ok, we will look into it, as those two versions shouldn't be so different in this regard.
In the meantime, you could try the following:
- Close the project, delete the Library folder and then reopen the project
- If it doesn't work:
- Delete both the Library and the `com.ptc.vuforia.engine-*.tgz` in the Packages folder
- Remove the `com.ptc.vuforia.engine` package from the `manifest.json` file
- Delete the `Assets/Editor/Migration` folder in your project
- Reopen the project
- If you have compilation errors, you might need to use an [Assembly Definition](https://docs.unity3d.com/6000.0/Documentation/Manual/cus-asmdef.html) file to make the project compile again. You could check out our [Vuforia Core Samples](https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/templates/packs/vuforia-core-samples-99026) to see how we did that for the scripts in that project
- When the project compiles, reimport Vuforia 11
- If this still doesn't work, import Vuforia in a new Unity 6 project and try to set up your scene in a similar way to see if the problem appears again
We are working on releasing official support for Unity 6 soon and any input is greatly appreciated, so please let us know if you try all of this and how it goes!
Hope this helps,
Ettore
