Comment 4 | author: TylerTemp | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 8 | url: https://github.com/dbrizov/NaughtyAttributes/issues/369#issuecomment-1874907288
OK after some digging here is the thing
1. It's not possible to render ToolKit inside IMGUI
2. It's possible to render IMGUI to ToolKit in `public override VisualElement CreatePropertyGUI(SerializedProperty property)`
```csharp
VisualElement container = new VisualElement();
IMGUIContainer imGuiContainer = new IMGUIContainer(() =>
{
myDrawerTool.MyImGuiDraw(myRect, property, label);
});
imGuiContainer.style.height = myRect.height;
container.Add(imGuiContainer);
return container;
```
3. As this makes the whole thing a callback, many things that are easy in IMGUI becomes tricky. For example, you need to call `property.serializedObject.ApplyModifiedProperties();` which is unnecessary for IMGUI PropertyDrawer
4. And yes, a hell lots of adaption for this change... (Odin actually supports UIToolKit+IMGUI by this IMGUIContainer , but in my test case, oddly, IMGUI sometimes does not work very well in Odin)
(I'm trying to implement it in [my util project](https://github.com/TylerTemp/SaintsField/) and, yes, it's hell lot of pain...)
Comment 5 | author: TylerTemp | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/dbrizov/NaughtyAttributes/issues/369#issuecomment-1891614195
> Sorry about this work that the Unity upgrade has brought to the surface. I feel like the bearer of bad news.
Well, agreed...
I just adapted [my project `SaintsField`](https://github.com/TylerTemp/SaintsField/) to support UI Toolkit. And I completely rewrite every components. I don't think there is a shortcut.
(If you like it please give a star, thanks!)
And my experience about UI Toolkit as an editor extension, is painful. Yes it's delightful how easy to handle elements and style, but most things are missing for editor. I quote from my project's README:
> 1. Label width. UI Toolkit uses a fixed label width 120px. However, this value is different when the field is nested and indented.
>
> In IMGUI, we have `EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth`, `EditorGUI.indentLevel`, which is absolutly not avaliable in UI Toolkit, and there is no way to get the label width. `SaintsField` just use the fixed label width.
>
> 2. Even most UI Toolkit fields are fixed label width, there is one that the label width behavior exactly like IMGUI: `PropertyField`. This bug has been reported to Unity (Sorry I can't find the link now), but is never fixed.
>
> `SaintsField` heavily relies on `PropertyField` to fallback the appearence. This is not even fixable at this point. If you try to obtain the info by query out the `PropertyField` element, you'll notice that Unity is internally using a script (rather than a uss style) to update it's label width.
>
> Even without using any custom inspector, if you use your UI Toolkit `PropertyDrawer` with default fields, your inspector label will not aligned, and makes it look really rediculous.
>
> This is not fixable.
>
> 3. `PropertyField` of an `Object` will give an error when click: `NullReferenceException: ... UnityEditor.ProjectBrower.FrameObject...`. Clicking will still lead you to active the target object, but I have no idea where this came from. Even official's example will have this error if you just add a `PropertyField` to it. Clicking on the error message will lead to the `Console` tab's layout got completely messed up.
>
> This is not fixable.
>
> 4. `DropdownField` will tread a label's change as a value change... I have no idea why this happens and why only `DropdownField`. Luckily this change event will give a `newValue=null` so I can work around with it.
My project is very new and not fully tested. For people who want a stable editor plus UI Toolkit? Yeah, just pay for OdinInspector...
------------------------------
Edit:
Oh, and also, when leaving an `PropertyDrawer` when active a new target, the old one's `CreatePropertyGUI` will also get called once. It's not a big deal in most case, but... I just don't know why, and how, and what?
Comment 6 | author: TylerTemp | association: NONE | reactions: 2 | score: 9 | url: https://github.com/dbrizov/NaughtyAttributes/issues/369#issuecomment-2093960255

# Unity Editor crashes (SIGSEGV) when the server receives a command while reloading the domain

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/yucchiy/UniCli/issues/118

Unity Editor crashes inconsistently when executing `unicli exec Compile` multiple times.
This may be related to https://github.com/yucchiy/UniCli/issues/104, but the error logs look different.
### How to reproduce
Spam `unicli exec Compile` until the Editor crashes. It may take 3-5 attempts.
### Log
```

### Environment

OS: Windows 11
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: paq | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 2 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/yucchiy/UniCli/issues/118#issuecomment-4050917193
https://github.com/yucchiy/UniCli/blob/25d0edfbebc58faec98eabf30396d74ab47302fd/src/UniCli.Unity/Packages/com.yucchiy.unicli-server/Editor/PipeServer.cs#L62-L67
I found `PipeOptions.Asynchronous` suspicious and think it may be the cause of the problem. Since the Unity Editor script runs on the main thread, using asynchronous pipe options seems unsuitable, though I am not 100% certain.
@yucchiy Is it okay to go ahead and change PipeServer to use a synchronous approach? (`PipeOptions.None`)
Comment 2 | author: yucchiy | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/yucchiy/UniCli/issues/118#issuecomment-4051374282
@paq
Your observation seems reasonable to me. I also suspect that around the domain reload boundary, some UniCli server tasks, such as command acceptance and in-flight processing, may be left in an indeterminate state, and that this is what eventually leads to the crash.
As a direction for fixing this, I believe that at minimum, the tasks owned by the UniCli server need to be shut down synchronously during server shutdown.
That said, this likely requires a somewhat larger refactor, and I do not think I have fully clarified the problem on my side yet.
So before I suggest a concrete fix, I would like a bit more time to investigate and think through the solution properly.
It would be very helpful if you could share more details about reproduction.
Is the issue basically reproducible by running `unicli exec Compile` many times, especially concurrently?
Also, have you noticed any pattern in terms of packages or plugins that make the issue easier to reproduce?
For example, are there certain packages installed that seem to increase the likelihood of the crash?
Comment 3 | author: paq | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 2 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/yucchiy/UniCli/issues/118#issuecomment-4051474657
@yucchiy Thank you for swift reply!
> It would be very helpful if you could share more details about reproduction.
> Is the issue basically reproducible by running unicli exec Compile many times, especially concurrently?
Just running another command after a compile, sequentially, seems to be enough to crash it.
Here is a stress test script to reproduce the SIGSEGV crash:
```bash
for round in $(seq 1 10); do
echo "=== Round $round ==="
unicli exec Compile --json &
unicli exec PlayMode.Enter --json &
unicli exec PlayMode.Exit --json &
unicli eval "$(cat <<'EOF'
return "stress round";
EOF
)" --json &
wait
echo ""
done
```
I haven't yet tested whether this reproduces on macOS as well. This may not reproduce on macOS.
> For example, are there certain packages installed that seem to increase the likelihood of the crash?
I'm using UniCli.Unity project in the repository. It is a clean project.
PS: The Reload Domain setting in EditorSettings does not seem to be related to the crash, regardless of whether it is enabled or disabled.
Comment 4 | author: paq | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 2 | score: 8 | url: https://github.com/yucchiy/UniCli/issues/118#issuecomment-4051590932
@yucchiy I noticed that `HandleClientAsync` tasks are not tracked anywhere.
https://github.com/yucchiy/UniCli/blob/d7f3db20face92aace6ffc4e2d329f9ed8ba7a92/src/UniCli.Unity/Packages/com.yucchiy.unicli-server/Editor/PipeServer.cs#L71-L72
The server loop itself runs on a ThreadPool thread (**Thread Pool A**) via `Task.Run`.
https://github.com/yucchiy/UniCli/blob/d7f3db20face92aace6ffc4e2d329f9ed8ba7a92/src/UniCli.Unity/Packages/com.yucchiy.unicli-server/Editor/PipeServer.cs#L31
I am not assure the following is correct: **Thread Pool A** executes the continuation after `WaitForConnectionAsync` completes, launches `HandleClientAsync`, and then enters the next `WaitForConnectionAsync`. During that time, **Thread Pool A** may pick up other work from the queue, so when `ReadAsync` inside `HandleClientAsync` completes, a different thread (**Thread Pool B**) may pick up that continuation by the ThreadPool scheduler.
When `Dispose` is called on Unity domain reload, `_cts.Cancel()` signals the server loop and `_serverLoop.Wait(500ms)` returns once **Thread Pool A** finishes. However, `HandleClientAsync` tasks running on **Thread Pool B** are not awaited. Those tasks may still have live continuations executing when the Mono domain is torn down, causing a SIGSEGV.
Comment 5 | author: paq | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 2 | score: 8 | url: https://github.com/yucchiy/UniCli/issues/118#issuecomment-4051592716
The following is a diagram describes the issue, drawn by Claude Code (Opus 4.6):
(it may be wrong, but seems helpful)
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
participant Main as Unity Main Thread
participant TPA as ThreadPool A<br/>(ServerLoop)
participant TPB as ThreadPool B<br/>(HandleClient)
participant Mono as Mono Runtime
Note over Main: Domain reload triggered<br/>(e.g. Compile command)
Main->>TPA: PipeServer constructor<br/>Task.Run(RunLoopAsync)
TPA->>TPA: AcceptClientAsync()<br/>WaitForConnectionAsync()
Note over TPA: Client connects
TPA->>TPB: _ = HandleClientAsync() 🔥<br/>(fire-and-forget, untracked)
TPA->>TPA: Next AcceptClientAsync()<br/>WaitForConnectionAsync()
TPB->>TPB: ReadRequestAsync()<br/>ProcessCommandAsync()
Note over Main: beforeAssemblyReload fires
Main->>Main: StopServer()<br/>→ UniCliServer.Dispose()
Main->>Main: UniCliServer.Stop()<br/>→ _cts.Cancel()
Main->>TPA: _serverLoop.Wait(500ms)
Note over TPA: CancellationToken fires<br/>RunLoopAsync exits
TPA-->>Main: _serverLoop completes ✅
Note over Main: Dispose() returns.<br/>Domain reload proceeds.
Note over TPB: ⚠️ HandleClientAsync still alive!<br/>ReadAsync / WriteAsync continuation<br/>pending on ThreadPool B
Main->>Mono: Begin MonoManager ReloadAssembly
Mono->>Mono: Tear down managed domain<br/>Console streams destroyed
TPB->>Mono: Continuation resumes<br/>accesses destroyed objects
Note over TPB,Mono: 💥 SIGSEGV / NullReferenceException<br/>StreamWriter.CheckAsyncTaskInProgress()
```
Comment 6 | author: yucchiy | association: OWNER | reactions: 2 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/yucchiy/UniCli/issues/118#issuecomment-4053380912
@paq
I've opened a draft PR (#119) that addresses this crash. The fix ensures all async I/O and ThreadPool callbacks are fully drained before domain reload proceeds, rather than adjusting PipeOptions or timeouts.
Key changes:
- Track and await all active client tasks in PipeServer instead of fire-and-forget
- Avoid disposing the linked CancellationTokenSource while native I/O callbacks are in-flight (this was likely the direct cause of the Mono crash)
- Dispose the accepting pipe explicitly to unblock WaitForConnectionAsync
@paq Could you try reproducing the crash with this branch (fix/issue-118-reload-safe-shutdown-v2)? I haven't been able to test on the Windows environment where the original crash was reported.

Comment 5 | author: Keranik | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/Keranik/COI-Extended/issues/152#issuecomment-2997808335
Thanks for the detailed report about the mod crashing when alt-tabbing or clicking another window during save loading. Your observations point to a clear cause, and I’d like to explain what’s likely happening.
The base game uses a main thread to handle OS interactions (like window events) and a separate simulation thread for game logic. This keeps the game responsive when you alt-tab or lose focus, as the main thread continues to communicate with the OS. However, the mod runs some operations—likely during save loading—on the main thread, causing it to become temporarily unresponsive. On Windows, this results in a "Not Responding" state until the operation finishes, but the game usually recovers. On Linux via Proton, when the game loses focus (e.g., during alt-tabbing), Proton seems to interpret the main thread’s unresponsiveness as a crash and terminates the process, leading to the issue you’re seeing.
This explains why the crashes are sporadic, only occur with the mod enabled, and are triggered by alt-tabbing or clicking outside the window. It also aligns with your finding that keeping the game in focus during loading reduces the issue. The mod’s use of the main thread for these tasks is the key difference from the base game’s threading approach.
Fixing this would require moving the mod’s operations to a separate thread, but this isn’t practical due to the complexity of passing data between threads in the game’s current design. As a result, the best workaround is to avoid alt-tabbing or clicking outside the game during the short save-loading period. You’ve already noted this helps, so staying focused on the game window during loading should minimize the issue.
If you have any further questions or run into other problems, feel free to let me know!

# [BUG]: Every level fails to load (intended lack of configurability?)

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/XuuXiaolan/CodeRebirth/issues/68

### Installation Method
r2modman / r2mm
### What happened?
Attempting to land on any moon results in a brief lag then followed by either a ship door that refuses to open and doesn't load the level or a loading screen interface that continues on forever until you quit the lobby.
It is also no longer possible to discover or configure any of the Giant enemy types in the LethalQuantities .json,. Any that were supposed to spawn get instantly removed from the .json on startup
### What did you do?
I replaced TheGiantSpecimens with the CodeRebirth package and all its dependencies, but it has suddenly caused the game to be unplayable for the time being. Upon testing every mod installed, uninstalling LethalQuantities has caused the mod to appear to work and load the levels with the new content, but at the cost of losing most level and enemy spawn configurability, including on other custom moons. I don't see a config to allow these features to be reenabled, and according to the Oxyde's entry in LethalLevelLoader, it might actually be intended. Though it was unclear from the mod descriptions if CodeRebirth was meant to override settings from LethalQuantities. TheGiantSpecimens had no issues up until the merge with CodeRebirth
### Version
v69
### What OS are you running?
Windows 10
### List of mods used
0198032e-66e3-3b8f-437a-ce8d39e9efe5
LethalQuantities seems to be the only mod to break the gameplay, the rest appear to work alongside it, albeit with the occasional red BepInEx log. The main error which stopped the ship from landing can be found below

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/adjust/unity_sdk/issues/330

Hi! We are facing NullRef exception during cold app starts without any attribution present.
```
NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
AdjustSdk.JSONNode.Parse (System.String aJSON) (at <00000000000000000000000000000000>:0)
AdjustSdk.AdjustAttribution..ctor (System.String jsonString) (at <00000000000000000000000000000000>:0)
AdjustSdk.AdjustiOS+<>c__DisplayClass111_0.<AttributionGetterMonoPInvoke>b__0 () (at <00000000000000000000000000000000>:0)
AdjustThreadDispatcher.Update () (at <00000000000000000000000000000000>:0)
```
Adjust: 5.1.2
Platform: iOS (probably same behavior for Android)
XCode: 15.4
Unity: 2022.3.52f
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: uerceg | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/adjust/unity_sdk/issues/330#issuecomment-2714948439
Hey @AndrewUrbanovich,
Thanks for reporting this. Are you getting this when you are trying to initialize SDK during the `InitSdk` call or at some other moment?

@uerceg I suppose it's on GetAttribution call right after InitSdk
```
Adjust.InitSdk(adjustConfig);
Adjust.GetAttribution(AttributionChangedHandler);
```
Comment 3 | author: AndrewUrbanovich | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 5 | url: https://github.com/adjust/unity_sdk/issues/330#issuecomment-2717270358
@uerceg yesterday it was happening on every launch, but now I can't reproduce this.
Maybe it was happening because it couldn't find an attribution for some reason, NullRef should happen if attribution string is null because there are no null checks during JSON parsing.
But I'm not sure how to make it happen again.
Comment 4 | author: AndrewUrbanovich | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 8 | url: https://github.com/adjust/unity_sdk/issues/330#issuecomment-2743335281

Comment 1 | author: FirstGearGames | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/FirstGearGames/FishNet/issues/881#issuecomment-2790219254
In the future please use our bug reporting guidelines, it helps us tremendously in isolating and resolving bugs faster.
Far as this issue goes, it shouldn't be possible. Your stack trace in the NetworkTransform starts on PostTick, but the NetworkTransform doesn't subscribe to PostTick until the network initializes. At the same time, it also instantiates the variable you're receiving a null reference for.
Updating the GetChanged method to this should resolve if the assumed variable is in-fact null.
```cs
private ChangedDelta GetChanged(TransformData transformData)
{
//If default return full changed.
if (transformData == null || transformData.IsDefault)
return _fullChanged;
/* If parent behaviour exist.
* Parent isn't sent as a delta so
* if it exist always send regardless
* of the previously sent transform
* data. */
return GetChanged(transformData.Position, transformData.Rotation, transformData.Scale, transformData.ParentBehaviour);
}
```
Can you please upload a package to these guidelines so this can be looked into further https://fish-networking.gitbook.io/docs/manual/guides/creating-bug-reports#guidelines
Or, update your git to have everything used in a sub-folder so that single folder and can imported into a project.
Thank you!

I went to take a look today but I really cannot sort through such a large project. It looks like there's a lot of files in there that are not required, such as ProBuilder, and I'm sure others. The files should be in there own folder as well so that it can be imported into our test project, without needing to create or open a new Unity project.
If it's only happening in builds make sure stripping settings are off, then try again.
If you are on Pro also try unchecking Strip Release Builds -> FishNet -> Configuration
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/21cad2cf-094c-4d76-a2b6-9e9a12013679)
Comment 5 | author: FirstGearGames | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/FirstGearGames/FishNet/issues/881#issuecomment-2817233503
Was it code stripping you used that caused issues or unity build stripping? I just want to be sure I look into this properly.
Comment 6 | author: FirstGearGames | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/FirstGearGames/FishNet/issues/881#issuecomment-2832273733
Ah okay. From what I read it sounds like you are starting host (server + client) in a build, and you get the error, correct?
If so, that sounds as though code stripping is working properly.
When you make a GUI build (as release) server code is removed from it. These means server-side content is not initializing or known in the build. Since you are starting as host the build is trying to access the removed content, which does not exists.
There is no point to enable code stripping if you're running as host since you need both the server and client code to be present to host.

can confirm. this is happening when `HideManagerGameObject = false` in BepInEx.cfg. gonna have to figure out why. you can remedy this for now by downgrading to automessage v1.1.1. thank u for the bug report
Comment 2 | author: hoffor | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/hoffor/MyLethalCompanyMods/issues/7#issuecomment-2659179572
i don't quite understand what the bepinex setting does but it's recommended to remain `false` or else plugins may break according to bepinex dev. it's the single toggle that stop it from nullreferencing when automessage is the only other plugin installed. i forgot i had it at `true` for one reason or another. debugging the plugin now
Comment 3 | author: hoffor | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/hoffor/MyLethalCompanyMods/issues/7#issuecomment-2659267983
fixed. thunderstore should update the mod version within the next few hours. if you want it now here's the .zip (you can just replace the contents of `BepInEx\plugins\hoffr-AutoMessage\` with these)
[hoffr-AutoMessage-2.0.1.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18799271/hoffr-AutoMessage-2.0.1.zip)
technical bugfix details: monobehaviour coroutines require a gameobject attached to them to function, and this plugin did not have one because it relied on bepinex's manager gameobject instead. looking through bepinex source code i'm unable to see why not hiding that gameobject would somehow cause my plugin to... not see it? seems pretty backward, no idea. regardless, seems safe to just have our plugin use its own gameobject instead
oh just noticed that some plugins set it to `true` when the game launches, which would explain why in large modpacks it might perform just fine. unsure which plugins these are rn

> oh just noticed that some plugins set it to true when the game launches, which would explain why in large modpacks it might perform just fine. unsure which plugins these are rn
@hoffor SoundTool will require modify this setting, the reason i uninstall that; but, i did checked with v2.0.0 and `HideManagerGameObject = false`, i spend some time to check this issue and i can confirm why in some large modpack don't need this option, `BetterSpectate` mod has `base.gameObject.hideFlags = HideFlags.HideAndDontSave;`
Comment 5 | author: CoolLKKPS | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 8 | url: https://github.com/hoffor/MyLethalCompanyMods/issues/7#issuecomment-2660586550
additionally, if u r making modpack and get similar issues, :
not only `BetterSpectate` mod:
1. BetterSpectate by Fusition (Alternative solution: FPSSpectate by DeathWrench)
2. StaticNetcodeLib by xilophor
3. CruiserTunes by Mellowdy
Comment 6 | author: hoffor | association: OWNER | reactions: 2 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/hoffor/MyLethalCompanyMods/issues/7#issuecomment-2668768894
> Looks another mod forked ur mod and u might need to check: https://github.com/Enovale/LoadingTips
bit off topic so i've enabled a [discussions section](https://github.com/hoffor/MyLethalCompanyMods/discussions) for anything that doesn't warrant an issue
but just for a quick dive into it, it's pretty cool someone liked the idea for this plugin enough to rebuild it from scratch (not a fork). immediate differences i notice:
- message count seems infinite, dunno when you'd ever need >100 but a fair change, adds a tiny bit more complexity to configuration
- titles don't always add `: ` (btw i just realized you can use `\n` for new lines in either of our plugins that's pretty cool)
- randomization i'm a bit iffy on considering unless there are only 2 msgs, mine has 0 chance to do msg #1 -> 2 -> 1 and i don't think anyone would catch onto a list of 10+ msgs looping one scrambled order unless the play session is maybe 5+ hours
- the text body cuts off really early
- less documentation
- unsure why it's not a fork considering it's functionally like 95% similar
but hey it's still pretty cool and i'm sure some of that is subject to change anyway. always open to forks and re-envisionings

This happened on one of our poorly maintained projects. While the project had EDM installed in UPM, a fellow brogrammer imported some unrelated .unitypackage with embedded EDM. So there are two EDM's now, and it became to behave poorly.

Comment 6 | author: 4314Games | association: NONE | reactions: 4 | score: 14 | url: https://github.com/googlesamples/unity-jar-resolver/issues/676#issuecomment-2324507710
Howdy yall, I recently updated some unity projects from 2021.3.26- to 2021.3.43 and was running into this exception and had other issues with the EDM. Mine were because of this line
`<projectSetting name="Google.VersionHandler.VersionHandlingEnabled" value="False" />`
in the ProjectSettings/GvhProjectSettings.xml file. I removed it and was able to build, I think it was added from an old SDK as none of my new SDKs were adding it. Good luck!
Edit: Ok I decided to look into this a little bit further. So unity will try to delete this line at build time, but if you import EDM 1.2.182 when the GvhProjectSettings file exsists in the project and this line also already exsists in that file this fails to happen and the android resolver menu wont show. Builds may still succeed though but I dont think the android resolver can run so errors will happen eventually I imagine. Tested in 2021.3.26, not going to go into more detail as this ticket is closed but if it reopens and needs a hand tag me :)

@tari-cat

Comment 4 | author: tari-cat | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/tari-cat/CustomGraffiti/issues/4#issuecomment-2017127973
One last thing that you could do to track down the bug is to:
- Make sure you're using the latest version of this mod
- Remove all other mods
- From a fresh save file, try spraying small graffiti with the mod installed with custom graffiti in folders or not
- Send the logs if the bug happens again
I apologize for the trouble, but I've had a hard time replicating this issue with multiple people including myself reporting no issues. Thanks in advance.

# Failed to initialize Vuforia Engine

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/juicycleff/flutter-unity-view-widget/issues/37

I have made Unity Project with Vuforia and It is working in mobile by "Build and Run" in Unity Editor.
Now I am integrating same project in Flutter so I have exported project to flutter.
**I am facing below issue:**
`I/Unity ( 3247): Vuforia.PlatformRuntimeInitialization:InitPlatform()
I/Unity ( 3247):
I/Unity ( 3247): (Filename: ./Runtime/Export/Debug/Debug.bindings.h Line: 35)
I/Unity ( 3247):

I/Unity ( 3247): Vuforia.VuforiaRuntime:InitVuforia()`
![Screenshot_20190830-085853](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16913432/63991864-01fbce80-cb07-11e9-8a9b-52649d8edf00.png)

Comment 1 | author: kamlesh9070 | association: NONE | reactions: 6 | score: 4 | url: https://github.com/juicycleff/flutter-unity-view-widget/issues/37#issuecomment-527847230
@juicycleff Waiting your response for this issue.
Comment 2 | author: thomas-stockx | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/juicycleff/flutter-unity-view-widget/issues/37#issuecomment-536480397
I've never used this with Vuforia, only with AR Foundation (Unity's wrapper around ARCore and ARKit). According to the docs @juicycleff has had this working at some point, so he should know what's going on.
Comment 3 | author: PiotrxKolasinski | association: NONE | reactions: 8 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/juicycleff/flutter-unity-view-widget/issues/37#issuecomment-547653791
It works for me :)
1. Change in file build.gradle: implementation(name: 'VuforiaWrapper', ext:'aar') to implementation project(':VuforiaWrapper')
2. In settings.gradle in the first line at the end add: ':VuforiaWrapper'
3. From menu: File -> New -> New Module choose "import .JAR/.AAR Package" and add lib VuforiaWrapper.arr. Move generated folder to android/
4. In Widget UnityWidget add field: isARScene: true
5. Your App need camera permission (you can set in settings on mobile)
Comment 4 | author: thomas-stockx | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 5 | url: https://github.com/juicycleff/flutter-unity-view-widget/issues/37#issuecomment-547774274
Thanks Piotrx, I'll add those steps in the README :)
Comment 5 | author: slimmziy | association: NONE | reactions: 4 | score: 11 | url: https://github.com/juicycleff/flutter-unity-view-widget/issues/37#issuecomment-653869690
I get this problem not solved by the above answer,
My first run on the app just runs fine,
But seconds and more, when i tried to open the Unity widget screen on my app, it crashed and show the same message as this post,
Here's my case,
*Working
1. Open freshly installed app
2. Open the unity scene screen
3. App ask for camera permission (grant it)
4. The scene opened
*Not working
1. Open again the app i mentioned
2. Open the unity scene again
3. The error pops up
*Solution
1. Open app info and ungrant the camera permission
2. Open the app again like it freshly installed, and the *working steps work
I find out the vuforia or the unity itself requesting for Camera Permission in order to initiate, any way to fix this? Or disable the permission? Or something?
Please help me on how to solve this, it's so annoying to ungrant the camera permission everytime i open the app

# Server does not seem to be set up correctly

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/jammsen/docker-the-forest-dedicated-server/issues/47

I am having an issue with the setup of the server.
I am able to connect to it via my local IP, however when attempting to connect to it via external IP it fails with the above listed error.
I believe it to be a firewall issue, however my firewall is open and other things through docker work fine.
The only thing I have done differently from the readme is I did not specifically put the files in the srv directory listed in the readme.
_3. Create 2 directories on your Dockernode (/srv/tfds/steamcmd and /srv/tfds/game)_

### Description
When the Changes tab is selected, even if the GitHub window is hidden/not actively being rendered, certain triggers cause the following error:
```
ArgumentException: You can only call GUI functions from inside OnGUI.
UnityEngine.GUIUtility.CheckOnGUI () (at C:/buildslave/unity/build/Modules/IMGUI/GUIUtility.cs:293)

```
This error only occurs once or twice sometimes per trigger, after which the console will start getting spammed with the following error.
```
NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object

UnityEditor.EditorApplication.Internal_CallUpdateFunctions () (at C:/buildslave/unity/build/Editor/Mono/EditorApplication.cs:303)
```
The first error above appearently breaks something about the current instance of the GitHub window. Reloading the window by closing it and reopening from the Window -> GitHub context fixes the problem, but while the problem is active the GitHub window will cause errors on every update function, as long as it is being rendered, regardless of which tab of the GitHub window is selected, until it is closed and reopened. Why it suddenly starts trying to call rendering code from inside Update is unknown to me at this moment.
### Notes about Reproducing
1. No clue how to reproduce, it just seems to happen sometimes, I just migrated from `2019.1.12f1` to `2019.2.0f1` on a project before it started spamming the console immediately.
2. In the past I've gotten the same error after a while, but it only effected certain tabs, this time it's effecting all tabs
3. Closing the tab and reopening it via "Window -> GitHub" no longer was spamming my console, so whatever was causing it is reset by reopening the window or cleaned up when closing.

```
And after that the window will start spamming NullReferenceExceptions in GitHub.Unity.Window.Update() while the GitHub tab is displayed, until the tab is closed and reopened.
Edit 2:
More details, As long as the currently selected tab on the GitHub window is "Branches" then even if the GitHub tab isn't active the first error listed above after the first edit still prints, the one about "You can only call GUI functions inside of OnGUI". The console will them start spamming like usual once you switch to the GitHub window again.
Edit 3:
Apparently playing in the editor isn't the only thing that triggers this issue. The recompiling step when the script assets change also causes the same problem. In both cases it only happens specifically for the Branches tab, none of the others.
Edit 4:
The problematic line seems to be:
https://github.com/github-for-unity/Unity/blob/092e13cccfdb405a9002da71df9d10d3f2242f0d/src/UnityExtension/Assets/Editor/GitHub.Unity/Misc/Styles.cs#L213
Specifically the call to get the skin property runs CheckOnGUI which errors if not called during the OnGUI stage. Since this style information isn't needed until you actually render it's likely tht the call to get the `Styles.ActiveBranchIcon` could be moved somehow to the start of the rendering loop, and lazy-initialized instead of setup in the OnEnable, or a way to detect the `Utility.IsDarkTheme` without a call to `GUI.skin`
Honestly why this only causes a problem during certain processes is beyond me, from what I see this should happen any time the window is open and not just under certain cases.

# MRTK Configurator Utility interrupts and staggers loading the editor, building, and changing scenes

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityToolkit-Unity/issues/7109

## Describe the bug
The MRTK Configurator seems pretty intrusive. It pops up when loading our updated project through script or through the hub, and seems to cause a state where Unity won't actually fully load (pausing the loading step) and takes a few minutes to unblock itself. It pops up repeatedly for projects where I have previously configured it through that utility, whether it's opening Unity, changing the scene, or changing to target platform.
There should be a way to tell the configurator to stop doing those checks automatically; as it will cause issues for projects with well-established build pipelines.
On a more personal note, this seems to be a bit much and if it can't be turned off I don't think it's something I could integrate since my coworkers would hate me as a result.
## To reproduce
Different steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Open a project with MRTK already integrated through the Unity Hub; it will appear before the Unity editor does
2. Open a project with MRTK already integrated through a script command; it will appear before the Unity editor does
3. With a project that has MRTK already integrated already open; switch the scene
4. With a project that has MRTK already integrated already open; switch the build target
4. Build a project that has MRTK integrated through a script; it will pop up and stagger the build until it resolves
All of these repro for the above steps even after the project has previously been configured through the configurator, or if you pressed ignore.
## Expected behavior
For it to pop up once when integrating MRTK for the first time, and then only again if access through editor UI.
## Your setup (please complete the following information)
- Unity Version 2018.4.8f1 (and repros on others as well)
- MRTK Version 2.3.0-20200115v2,
## Target platform (please complete the following information)
- HoloLens
- HoloLens 2
## Additional context
Add any other context about the problem here.

Comment 2 | author: Vectorial1024 | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/Tachyonite/Pawnmorpher/issues/592#issuecomment-1158922027
I was reading CHs decompiled code, and I have to say, it is a bit challenging to read their code because their way of doing compatibility and reflection is unusual, at least to me...
They seem to kind of hard-code something, eg I want to print some tooltip, so I make a new function for printing the tooltip, and then (if exists) I will then call specifically the function from EBF to add in their info, and continue with the rest of the flow.
I still do not understand what exactly is going on, but I am confident that "none of the 3 mods modified `Pawn.GetHealthScale`" is true.
What might be happening is that CH tried to handle something with the assumption that EBF and only EBF is loaded, but turns out PM is also loaded but CH did not know about it/did not see it. And behind the scenes, because EBF already knows about PM and have read a bit of their code, EBF decides not to do something when it sees PM, but CH relies on the "full set of behavior of EBF", so when EBF sees PM and refuse to do X, CH only sees EBF and expects X, which does not exist, leading to `null` somewhere.
We 3 mods are kinda spontaneously forming a circular loop, CH looks at EBF, EBF looks at PM, but then PM just sits there and thinking about what is going on with all the bug reports, and starts looking at CH. This can't be good.
This may be more difficult to solve than what it seems at the surface. We may need to realign some of the "looking directions" to form something consistent. But just saying, because I am still not yet sure what is going on.

Comment 4 | author: Vectorial1024 | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 8 | url: https://github.com/Tachyonite/Pawnmorpher/issues/592#issuecomment-1172192367
Update:
Apparently with some very very odd combinations, a `String` value was passed into a param spot expecting a `Pawn` value, so naturally you cannot find `MutationTracker` in a `String`. I am thinking this is the result of some strange transpilations, but I am still not sure.
Comment 5 | author: Vectorial1024 | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 8 | url: https://github.com/Tachyonite/Pawnmorpher/issues/592#issuecomment-1172225981
Breakthrough:
`Pawnmorph.GetTooltip:Transpiler` exists, and actively conflicts with other mods trying to modify the tooltip function through transpilers e.g. EBF. In effect, Pawnmorpher is able to put their patches before e.g. EBF, and so the functions inside EBF was fed with unexpected values such as a `String` => `30 / 30`. And then something normally impossible like "reading a MutationTracker property from a String" happened; normally this would be blocked at compilation step.
We therefore need to come up with a good solution to fix this cleanly on both sides.
Update: I think I got it: I will just let Pawnmorpher patch a few of the methods for EBF and hopefully we will not conflict.
Comment 6 | author: Vectorial1024 | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/Tachyonite/Pawnmorpher/issues/592#issuecomment-1186139671
EBF has released the Community Unification update which pretty much solved this. Now, EBF has a different aapproach when interacting with PM (see https://github.com/Vectorial1024/EliteBionicsFramework/issues/34 for the details and a known harmless error message).
You may close this anytime.

Hello, thank you for using `ros2-for-unity`!
Did you include `source /opt/ROS/foxy/setup.bash` line in `~/.profile` file? If yes - did you restart ubuntu?
If you did not use `profile` file, then how did you launch the editor? If you run `source /opt/ROS/foxy/setup.bash` in a console then you have to run the editor within the same console or it won't use the sourced variables. To launch editor in console window:
`<PATH_TO_UNITY_EDITOR> -projectPath <PATH_TO_PROJECT>`
Unity Editor is most commonly installed in `~/Unity/Hub/Editor/<VERSION>/Editor/Unity`.

Comment 1 | author: sinai-dev | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/sinai-dev/UnityExplorer/issues/121#issuecomment-1057202247
Hmm yeah I see, the `GetUnhollowedType` method would fail on generic types. We should be able to just do `Type.GetType()` for those I think, let me know if this version of UniverseLib fixes this issue.
[UniverseLib.IL2CPP.dll.zip](https://github.com/sinai-dev/UnityExplorer/files/8171717/UniverseLib.IL2CPP.dll.zip)
Comment 2 | author: sinai-dev | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/sinai-dev/UnityExplorer/issues/121#issuecomment-1057246714
I think it may actually be an issue with Unhollower, trying to reproduce it and I'm not too sure what's going on here.
I created this dictionary:
```cs
Il2CppSystem.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<Il2CppSystem.Object, Il2CppSystem.Object> aWeirdDictionary;
```
And then set a second dictionary as the value like so:
```cs
var value = new Il2CppSystem.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<Il2CppSystem.Object, Il2CppSystem.Object>();
value[(Il2CppSystem.String)"key"] = (Il2CppSystem.String)"value";
aWeirdDictionary[(Il2CppSystem.String)"one"] = value;
```
UnityExplorer successfully identifies and iterates the first Il2Cpp dictionary, so I think there are no actual issues with how that is working. But when we get to the second dictionary, things get weird...
```cs
var value = (UnityExplorer.Tests.TestClass.aWeirdDictionary["one"] as Il2CppSystem.Object);
Log(value.GetIl2CppType().FullName);
```
Logs this:
```
System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2[[System.Object, mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089],[System.Object, mscorlib, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089]]
```
Meaning that Unhollower(?) is telling us it's a `System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<System.Object, System.Object>`. So, I'm not sure if this is an issue with Unhollower or what, but yeah, something weird is going on here.
edit: actually yeah now I remember, Unhollower sometimes returns anything in `Il2CppSystem` as `System` for some reason. Usually UniverseLib corrects it to point to the `Il2CppSystem` one, but this doesn't happen for bound generic types. Might try to rewrite/rethink `GetActualType` and `TryCast`, or else I'll try to figure out a work around for bound generic types.
Comment 3 | author: sinai-dev | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/sinai-dev/UnityExplorer/issues/121#issuecomment-1057744869
~~Thought about this a bit more, I don't think there's anything we can do right now, it's unsolvable from outside Unhollower. The issue is that `GetIl2CppType` should not return `System` for `Il2CppSystem` types.~~
~~We could maybe just literally replace all `System.` with `Il2CppSystem.` before doing `GetUnhollowedType`, which UniverseLib does already do for some simple cases, but this would be impossible for generic types since we don't know whether it really was Il2Cpp or not, theoretically a type `Il2CppSystem.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<System.Object, Il2CppSystem.Object>` COULD exist, if defined by a user.~~
~~If you can find some way to identify the actual type of a generic `Il2CppSystem` type in this context please let me know, otherwise I think I'll have to close this for now and maybe open an issue with Unhollower.~~
edit: It seems I was mistaken, `System` types cannot actually be used as generic parameters for `Il2CppSystem` generic types as far as I can tell, it just instantly crashes, so maybe we can assume it will always be an Il2Cpp type.
I might be able to just Regex for the `mscorlib` AssemblyQualifiedName signature and replace it with the `Il2Cppmscorlib` one I guess? I'll see how that goes.
Comment 4 | author: sinai-dev | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/sinai-dev/UnityExplorer/issues/121#issuecomment-1057808314
That's odd, my first assumption would be that a generic parameter is being used which was not compiled with the original game, but if you're just patching a vanilla method then I guess that's unlikely?
Can you log `keyValues.Value.GetIl2CppType().AssemblyQualifiedName` for me?
Comment 5 | author: sinai-dev | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/sinai-dev/UnityExplorer/issues/121#issuecomment-1057857998
Hmm alright, I downloaded the game to see what's going on here, it's getting even weirder.
I changed the cast to `Il2CppSystem.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<System.String, Il2CppSystem.Object>` and it actually worked fine? Was able to iterate it and everything. So now I have to figure out when we don't want to actually change the System type to Il2Cpp, I'm guessing it will just be for strings and primitives?
Comment 6 | author: sinai-dev | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 15 | url: https://github.com/sinai-dev/UnityExplorer/issues/121#issuecomment-1057891081
Alright, I think this is working correctly now, let's hope my assumption about not fixing `System.String` and system primitives is correct.

@azzero Sorry for the late reply.
Let's try to clarify several things:
- Based on https://github.com/googlesamples/unity-jar-resolver/issues/430#issuecomment-812747123, seems like you no longer have error you mentioned in https://github.com/googlesamples/unity-jar-resolver/issues/430#issuecomment-812026650. Otherwise, the Android Resolver should not run at all.
- If you see the following error
```
Failed to fetch the following dependencies:
com.google.android.gms:play-services-ads:19.5.0
com.google.ads.mediation:inmobi:9.1.1.0
com.google.ads.mediation:mopub:5.10.0.0
```
This basically means that Android Resolver failed to resolve or download those libraries, which is certainly odd.
- The `Play Service Resolver` presented in [your project](https://github.com/azzero/holesAvoiderGameTest/tree/main/HoolsAvoidertest/Assets/PlayServicesResolver/Editor) is quite old. It is `1.2.124` comparing to the latest `1.2.164`.
There definitely something odd going on in your project.
Here is my suggestion: Remove Admob entirely from your project and reinstall the [latest Admob](https://github.com/googleads/googleads-mobile-unity/releases/tag/v5.4.0) again.
- First remove the following folders:
- `Assets/PlayServicesResolver`
- `Assets/GoogleMobileAds`
- Everything under `Assets/Plugin/Android` related to GoogleMobileAds
- Everything under `Assets/Plugin/iOS` started with `GADU`, ex. `GADUAdLoader.h`
- Download [latest Admob](https://github.com/googleads/googleads-mobile-unity/releases/tag/v5.4.0)
- Import it.
I trust Admob tested their latest SDK. If you still experience issues, I recommend you to report it on [Admob Github repo](https://github.com/googleads/googleads-mobile-unity/issues)
Let us know if this helps!

# [GLITCH] Strange POV bug on new server of mine.

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/SmartlyDressedGames/Unturned-3.x-Community/issues/2754

I am one of the owners and developers for a server called Uncreated Warfare. We recently rewrote our entire server, which brought a very strange bug that I've never seen before. Theres a youtube video linked below that shows many player's points of views (photos and videos). Basically they're just running around or driving and all the sudden their screen cuts to a low fov closeup of some iron sight or something. This happens to most of our players regularly, and seems to happen more as the player count rises. At the end of the video you can also see some desync that I assume is linked to this. I haven't been able to establish why it's happening, it seems so random.
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HBfoilkpclw](url) (only the fades are different video clips, jump cuts are part of one clip)
I've also attached a few client logs that were sent to us by players. there's nothing in the server log to indicate any problems, but I attached a server log as well.
What seems to happen in the client logs for each player is it sends
```
[Rocket.log](https://github.com/SmartlyDressedGames/Unturned-3.x-Community/files/6952504/Rocket.log)
[2021-08-08 21:53:03] Saved item hotkeys
```
then immediately starts spamming this in FixedUpdate until the player is kicked or their game is alt-f4'd.
```
[2021-08-08 21:53:03] NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
[2021-08-08 21:53:03] SDG.Unturned.Glazier_uGUI.LateUpdate () (at <febd787eb4b7412eb99c84755174c3ee>:0)

[2021-08-08 21:53:03] NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
[2021-08-08 21:53:03] SDG.Unturned.Glazier_uGUI.LateUpdate () (at <febd787eb4b7412eb99c84755174c3ee>:0)
```
Any help would be appreciated as I have no clue where to go from here.
[Rocket.log](https://github.com/SmartlyDressedGames/Unturned-3.x-Community/files/6952505/Rocket.log) // server log
[Client.log](https://github.com/SmartlyDressedGames/Unturned-3.x-Community/files/6952507/Client.log) // one hour behind server

Comment 4 | author: andriivitiv | association: NONE | reactions: 2 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/SmartlyDressedGames/Unturned-3.x-Community/issues/2754#issuecomment-895463933
```
Exception invoking SDG.Unturned.EffectManager.ReceiveUIEffect1Arg from server:
Index (zero based) must be greater than or equal to zero and less than the size of the argument list.
```
These indexes must start from zero (1, 2, and 3 in your case):
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/37713088/128759036-2c15116b-01e5-4702-bf20-fb4e6f3dc916.png)
Comment 5 | author: SDGNelson | association: MEMBER | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/SmartlyDressedGames/Unturned-3.x-Community/issues/2754#issuecomment-895488242
Judging by how the UI elements become darker one of your plugins may be respawning all of the UI elements every frame. If one of the UIs is a fullscreen grainy image that would explain why it gradually gets grainier. The only thing that would throw a null reference exception in Glazier_uGUI.LateUpdate is EventSystem.current, so my guess is that the huge number of UI elements is breaking something in Unity.
Comment 6 | author: SDGNelson | association: MEMBER | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/SmartlyDressedGames/Unturned-3.x-Community/issues/2754#issuecomment-895530277
Formatting text happens after everything important, so while you should fix that formatting issue it is probably not causing the duplicate UI problem. Nevertheless something is causing your UI to be repeatedly spawned without cleanup, so I would recommend investigating that further.

# SuperEditor Pro not working anymore on both MacOS and Windows

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/UnitySuperEditor/SuperEditor/issues/9

I bought the Pro version on Monday the 3rd of May and it was working properly event after I updated to version 1.21.

# Gestures do not work on HL2 with OpenXR or XR SDK (but in the Unity Editor Player)

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityToolkit-Unity/issues/9492

## Describe the bug
I cannot get Gestures to work on the Hololens 2 using either the 'DefaultOpenXRInputSystemProfile' or DefaultXRSDKInputSystemProfile'. They do work in the Unity Editor in Play mode.
I assume this is related to #9380 and #7271 for the XR SDK ?
Are Gestures currently supposed to work with OpenXR / the DefaultOpenXRInputSystemProfile?
Is there any way I can get Gestures to work on the Hololens 2 with my current MRTK and Unity Version or do I have to downgrade to Unity 2019.4, as mentioned here: [https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityToolkit-Unity/issues/7271#issuecomment-737202451](url)
My Gesture Manager class:
```csharp
using Microsoft.MixedReality.Toolkit;
using Microsoft.MixedReality.Toolkit.Input;
using UnityEngine;
public class AetherClickManager : InputSystemGlobalHandlerListener, IMixedRealityGestureHandler
{
public void OnGestureCanceled(InputEventData eventData)
{
//throw new System.NotImplementedException();
}
public void OnGestureCompleted(InputEventData eventData)
{
foreach(var ptr in eventData.InputSource.Pointers)
{
if(ptr.Result.CurrentPointerTarget == null)
{
ApplicationManager.Broadcast(ApplicationManager.Signal.SignalAetherClicked);
eventData.Use(); // Mark the event as used, so it doesn't fall through to other handlers.
}
}
}
public void OnGestureStarted(InputEventData eventData)
{
//throw new System.NotImplementedException();
}
public void OnGestureUpdated(InputEventData eventData)
{
//throw new System.NotImplementedException();
}
protected override void RegisterHandlers()
{
CoreServices.InputSystem?.RegisterHandler<IMixedRealityGestureHandler>(this);
}
protected override void UnregisterHandlers()
{
CoreServices.InputSystem?.UnregisterHandler<IMixedRealityGestureHandler>(this);
}
}
```
## To reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Implement InputSystemGlobalHandlerListener, IMixedRealityGestureHandler
2. Build using either 'DefaultOpenXRInputSystemProfile' or DefaultXRSDKInputSystemProfile' and Run on Hololens 2
3. No Gesture Handler function is called
## Expected behavior
```OnGestureCompleted(InputEventData eventData)``` should be called
## Your setup (please complete the following information)
- Unity Version 2020.2.2f1
- MRTK Version 2.6.1
## Target platform (please complete the following information)
- HoloLens 2
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: keveleigh | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 2 | score: 9 | url: https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityToolkit-Unity/issues/9492#issuecomment-797653867
>Are Gestures currently supposed to work with OpenXR / the DefaultOpenXRInputSystemProfile?
Currently, no. We're going through planning now to see how to best support them, since the APIs have changed a bit.
Comment 2 | author: atiemark | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityToolkit-Unity/issues/9492#issuecomment-798062295
Allright, thank you - So an option to work with Gestures on HL2 right now is to downgrade to Unity 2019.4, as mentioned here: https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityToolkit-Unity/issues/7271#issuecomment-737202451
Is this info still up-to-date?
Comment 3 | author: keveleigh | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 2 | score: 8 | url: https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityToolkit-Unity/issues/9492#issuecomment-799623756
Correct. The legacy XR pipeline is currently the only one that supports gestures (which is the one that's been removed in 2020).
Comment 4 | author: keveleigh | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 4 | score: 14 | url: https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityToolkit-Unity/issues/9492#issuecomment-799839909
Yeah, if you're using `DefaultXRSDKInputSystemProfile` that means you've updated to XR SDK. Gestures only works on legacy XR at the moment, so you'll want to use the DefaultMixedRealityToolkitConfigurationProfile and ensure you've set up XR via the old Player Settings -> UWP -> XR Settings (as opposed to XR Plugin Management)

Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: jamcohen | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/google/play-unity-plugins/issues/75#issuecomment-742174511
Hi evertonfd,
I'm sorry you're running into issues.
The currentActivity error that you're seeing is indeed caused by running PlayAssetDelivery methods in the Editor. To diagnose the app crash you want to look at the logs generated on device using [`adb logcat`](https://developer.android.com/studio/command-line/logcat).
My guess from looking at the code is that your `DownloadAssets` coroutine is calling `PlayAssetDelivery.RetrieveAssetBundleAsync(assetBundleName)` every frame. `RetrieveAssetBundleAsync` will throw an exception if an assetBundle request already exists with that name. You should wrap your switch statement in a while loop, so that it only calls `PlayAssetDelivery.RetrieveAssetBundleAsync(assetBundleName)` once per assetBundleName.
Example:
````
IEnumerator DownloadAssets(Queue<string> assetBundleQueue)
{
while (assetBundleQueue.Count > 0)
{
string assetBundleName = assetBundleQueue.Dequeue();
Debug.Log("Getting scene bundle " + assetBundleName);
PlayAssetBundleRequest bundleRequest =
PlayAssetDelivery.RetrieveAssetBundleAsync(assetBundleName);
AssetDeliveryStatus status = bundleRequest.Status;
while(status != AssetDeliveryStatus.Failed && status != AssetDeliveryStatus.Loaded)
{
switch (status)
{
case AssetDeliveryStatus.Pending:
Debug.Log("Asset delivery status pending.");
yield return null;
break;
case AssetDeliveryStatus.Retrieving:
Debug.Log("Asset delivery status retrieving.");
yield return null;
break;
case AssetDeliveryStatus.Available:
case AssetDeliveryStatus.Loading:
Debug.Log("Asset delivery status loading.");
yield return null;
break;
case AssetDeliveryStatus.Loaded:
assetBundle = bundleRequest.AssetBundle;
scenePaths.Add(assetBundle.GetAllScenePaths());
Debug.Log("Asset delivery status loaded.");
break;
case AssetDeliveryStatus.Failed:
Debug.Log("Asset delivery status failed.");
break;
case AssetDeliveryStatus.WaitingForWifi:
Debug.Log("Asset delivery status waiting wi fi.");
yield return null;
break;
default:
break;
}
}
}
}
````
Comment 2 | author: jamcohen | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/google/play-unity-plugins/issues/75#issuecomment-742912711
`PlayAssetDelivery.RetrieveAssetBundleAsync()` is designed to be run only on the Android device, and will always throw that Exception when it is run in the Editor.
When you run "adb logcat", do you see the "Getting scene bundle" log?
Comment 3 | author: evertonfd | association: NONE | reactions: 2 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/google/play-unity-plugins/issues/75#issuecomment-743005571
No, I don't, it actually doesn't change much, I've tried placing this function on a button to trigger only later but nothing works, any function I call from the `PlayAssetDelivery` crashes the whole Class and stops any further code, I've tried `while (!PlayAssetDelivery.IsDownloaded(assetBundleName))`, but it crashes when it's called, I've tried `PlayAssetDelivery.GetDownloadSize`, but it also crashes, it seems that I'm calling a function that was not initialized, or something like that, but I've added `using Google.Play.AssetDelivery;`, I really don't know what to do, I've checked again the tutorial but got no further enlightment...
Comment 4 | author: jamcohen | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/google/play-unity-plugins/issues/75#issuecomment-743393738
PlayAssetDelivery methods call into an Android plugin that only works when running on an Android device. Otherwise they will throw the `type signature not found` exception. Using UnityRemote doesn't actually run the app on Android. It runs the app in the editor and streams the visual output to your device. That's why you're also seeing the exception when using UnityRemote.

# System.Reflection.Emit in AOT environment with code generation

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/10080

Hello,
In my Unity game I'm using AspNetCore SignalR to communicate between client and server. Since I'm preparing version for PS4 platform I'm running with IL2CPP scripting backend.
I generated resolvers for my classes with MessagePackCompiler, and on both sides (server and client) I initialize MessagePackProtocol with formatters that should work in AOT environment.
`
services.AddSignalR()
.AddMessagePackProtocol(options =>
{
options.FormatterResolvers = new List<IFormatterResolver>
{
GeneratedResolver.Instance,
MyOwnResolver.Instance,
BuiltinResolver.Instance,
AttributeFormatterResolver.Instance,
PrimitiveObjectResolver.Instance
};
});
`
However after building the project I'm getting this exception:
`
02:09:57 PlatformNotSupportedException: Operation is not supported on this platform.

Comment 1 | author: analogrelay | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/10080#issuecomment-491332054
Ah, it looks like even just constructing the default resolvers fails on these platforms. That's very unfortunate. You are overriding the defaults with ones that will work but before your code runs we initialize the list to the "default" value, which does construct these unsupported resolvers.
We'll have to look at if we can suppress these on IL2CPP environments.
There is a workaround but it's not pretty. You can copy the [`Protocols.MessagePack`](https://github.com/aspnet/AspNetCore/tree/master/src/SignalR/common/Protocols.MessagePack/src) project to your repo and modify `MessagePackHubProtocolOptions` to **not** pre-initialize the values. Then instead of calling `.AddMessagePackProtocol()`, register your forked version of `MessagePackHubProtocol` as a singleton in DI:
```csharp
services.AddSingleton<IHubProtocol, MyMessagePackHubProtocol>();
```
If you're interested in helping contribute a fix, we'd be happy to receive a PR (but we'll also look at doing this ourselves if you don't have time to send a PR). The critical aspects are this:
* We still need to initial the list to the default value on other platforms. It's important that user configuration be able to see the default resolvers in the list so they can remove/modify them.
* It seems to me the best approach may be to *detect* the IL2CPP environment somehow and avoid initializing this list in that situation.
In general, the AOT story for MessagePack is a little rough. We could use some help from people who are familiar with that environment to get it right :).

Comment 6 | author: BrennanConroy | association: MEMBER | reactions: 0 | score: 13 | url: https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/10080#issuecomment-651950100
```
x.SerializerOptions
.WithResolver(GeneratedResolver.Instance)
.WithCompression(MessagePackCompression.Lz4Block)
```
This is calling the getter which initializes the default options. If you want to avoid that you can't access the `SerializerOptions` property, you have to just set it with your own settings.
Example:
```
x.SerializerOptions = MessagePackSerializerOptions.WithResolver(GeneratedResolver.Instance)
.WithCompression(MessagePackCompression.Lz4Block)
```

<!-- source=github_issue; title=Change default logging for unhandled exceptions; url=https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask/issues/40 -->

# Change default logging for unhandled exceptions

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask/issues/40

Currently, an unhandled exception thrown in a `UniTask` will be logged as a warning. Normally, an unhandled exception would be logged by Unity with `Debug.LogException()`. This behavior can be changed by setting `UniTaskScheduler.UnobservedExceptionWriteLogType`:
```
UniTaskScheduler.UnobservedExceptionWriteLogType = LogType.Exception;
```
I think it's good that the behavior can be customized, but it would be better to have the default behavior match what Unity does by default.
If this is acceptable, I would be happy to open a pull request for the work! :grin:
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: randomPoison | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask/issues/40#issuecomment-620823278
If you log an exception with `Debug.LogException()`, the type of the exception is still logged. For example, with the following code:
```csharp
public class CustomExceptionTest : MonoBehaviour
{
private void Start()
{
Debug.LogException(new CustomException("This is a custom exception!"));
}
}
public class CustomException : Exception
{
public CustomException(string message) : base(message) { }
}
```
Unity logs the following
```text
CustomException: This is a custom exception!
UnityEngine.Debug:LogException(Exception)
CustomExceptionTest:Start() (at Assets/Scripts/CustomExceptionTest.cs:8)
```
I can also confirm that logging an exception with `Debug.LogException()` preserves the stack trace for the original exception:
```text
CustomException: Exception throw with callstack
CustomExceptionTest.SecretlyThrows () (at Assets/Scripts/CustomExceptionTest.cs:27)
CustomExceptionTest.DoAThing () (at Assets/Scripts/CustomExceptionTest.cs:22)
CustomExceptionTest.Start () (at Assets/Scripts/CustomExceptionTest.cs:12)
UnityEngine.Debug:LogException(Exception)
CustomExceptionTest:Start() (at Assets/Scripts/CustomExceptionTest.cs:16)
```
So it seems like using `Debug.LogException()` would be the best approach. Or am I misunderstanding what your original concern was?
Also, sorry for taking a long time to respond myself 😅
Comment 2 | author: neuecc | association: MEMBER | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask/issues/40#issuecomment-621188391
Unhandled exceptions are normally logged when GCed.
If it appears in a form similar to a normal log, will be confused as to where the log came from.
For that reason, the prefix "UnobservedTaskException:" is added.
Comment 3 | author: neuecc | association: MEMBER | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask/issues/40#issuecomment-622245407
The exception is raised from user code or `GC`.
to distinguish it.
Comment 4 | author: randomPoison | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask/issues/40#issuecomment-622475758
Sorry if I'm missing something obvious here, but I'm still not sure why logging with `LogError()` would be less confusing than logging with `LogException()` 😅 To better see how Unity handles uncaught exceptions I setup an example with some side-by-side comparisons. [You can see the test script here](https://github.com/randomPoison/UniTask/blob/7fee9f441558429e9bec7448c501071db82f6e85/Assets/ExceptionExamples.cs).
---
As a baseline, here's an uncaught exception thrown from regular (non-async) code. This is how Unity users are expecting uncaught exceptions to be handled. Double-clicking the log entry takes you to the place where the exception was thrown, and in Unity 2019 you can also click on each location in the stack trace.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1900829/80822783-0f3ef080-8ba1-11ea-8ba3-6f9aa61b6322.png)
---
This is what an uncaught exception looks like in `async void` function. This looks basically the same as an exception in non-async code. The stack trace is more complicated due to how `async` works, but double clicking the log entry still takes you to the place where the exception was thrown, and you can still click on each location in the exception's stack trace.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1900829/80823439-4366e100-8ba2-11ea-984c-a7409c8c28ae.png)
---
This is what an uncaught exception looks in a `UniTask` looks like if we configure `UniTaskScheduler` to log unobserved exceptions with `LogType.Exception`. This looks and behaves the same way as any other uncaught exception in terms of being able to jump directly to where the exception was thrown and being able to jump to any point in the exception's stack trace.
I do see what you mean about the exception showing up as "logged from user code", since you can also see `UniTaskScheduler` showing up below the exception's stack trace. However I don't think that's a big issue since the user still has full access to the exception's stack trace.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1900829/80823493-5aa5ce80-8ba2-11ea-9b8d-86a851d5fcfb.png)
---
This is what an uncaught exception looks like in a `UniTask` if we configure `UniTaskScheduler` to log unobserved exceptions with `LogType.Error`. Double clicking the log entry takes you to `UniTaskScheduler.cs` instead of where the the exception is logged. You can see all of the stack trace for the exception, but you can't click on the locations anymore. The only parts you can click on are the stack trace for where the log was made, which is inside of `UniTask` code rather than user code.
This seems more confusing to me as a Unity developer, since this behaves very differently than other uncaught exceptions.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1900829/80823639-9fca0080-8ba2-11ea-9f35-4b87784cf7e3.png)
---
Looking at how the exception is actually surfaced to users, I'm still not seeing how logging with `Debug.LogException()` is any more confusing. You don't have the explicit call out that the exception is coming from an unobserved task, however I don't think that matters in practice: Whether the exception was thrown from a task or from non-async code, it was unhandled either way. What's most important is that users are able to quickly identify why the exception was thrown, which is much harder to do when you can't easily jump to different parts of the stack trace.
At this point, I think it'd actually be better to remove the `UnobservedExceptionWriteLogType` configuration option and **always** log exceptions with `Debug.LogException()`. If users _really_ want to suppress uncaught exceptions, they would still be able to register a callback for the `UnobservedTaskException` event and log the exceptions however they want.
Hopefully that comparison makes sense! Please let me know if I'm still missing something about why it would be better to log with `Debug.LogError()` 😅
Comment 5 | author: neuecc | association: MEMBER | reactions: 10 | score: 19 | url: https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask/issues/40#issuecomment-624067383
@randomPoison
In your example, the `Throw from async Task` is not captured.
Normal tasks must be set explicitly via `TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException`.
In other words, this is where we identify whether it's Unobserved or not.
It's also listed at the top in Error.
```
UnobservedTaskException:System.Exception: Thrown from `async UniTask` function
at ExceptionExamples+<<ThrowFromUniTask>g__ThrowInner|7_0>d.MoveNext () [0x0006f] in C:\...\Scenes\ExceptionExamples.cs:72
```
The problem, however, is that, as you say, the InnerException dump is Log-unfriendly in Unity.
It's a choice between making the Log jump friendly or marking it as Unobserved.
Now, I think most people don't understand the meaning of Uobserved in the first place,
and jump-friendly seems to benefit a lot of people.
Ok, I'd like to make Exception the default, at least in v2.
Comment 6 | author: randomPoison | association: NONE | reactions: 4 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask/issues/40#issuecomment-624173306
You're right, there's not a lot of harm in leaving that option in there, especially if it's set to log using `Debug.LogException()` by default. However, there's also not much value in leaving it in I think. It's a bad practice to log exceptions with anything other than `Debug.LogException()`, so leaving that option in just allows users to make their projects harder to debug with no benefit. It also adds a bit of unnecessary code complexity to `UniTaskScheduler`. So even if there's not much harm in leaving it, I only see benefits to removing it.
That said, once the default is changed to `Debug.LogException()` my main concern will be addressed! So it won't matter a ton to me if you do leave it in.

<!-- source=github_issue; title=New Jar resolver removes Play Services library; url=https://github.com/googlesamples/unity-jar-resolver/issues/212 -->

# New Jar resolver removes Play Services library

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/googlesamples/unity-jar-resolver/issues/212

Because I encountered a crash in Firebase Remote Config when running version 1.2.102 of Play Services resolver (which updated some of the libraries) I decided to try an upgrade the resolver.
The new version (1.2.111) deleted all Play Services libraries but didn't install the new ones although it says "Resolution succeeded". So result is a project without Play Services libraries (which off course won't build)
I didn't change any other thing than updating the resolver (*Dependencies.xml files didn't change).
When running in the editor I get an error message (though I don't know if this causes the issue):
System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
at Google.VersionHandler.InvokeMethod (System.Type type, System.Object objectInstance, System.String methodName, System.Object[] args, System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2[TKey,TValue] namedArgs) [0x00054] in Z:\tmp\tmp.7eOCFUaXh7\third_party\unity\unity_jar_resolver\source\VersionHandler\src\VersionHandler.cs:506
at Google.VersionHandler.InvokeStaticMethod (System.Type type, System.String methodName, System.Object[] args, System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2[TKey,TValue] namedArgs) [0x00000] in Z:\tmp\tmp.7eOCFUaXh7\third_party\unity\unity_jar_resolver\source\VersionHandler\src\VersionHandler.cs:481
at Facebook.Unity.Editor.AndroidSupportLibraryResolver.setupDependencies () [0x00034] in <10e3a2e9d4094bf5b9409184a698ff5e>:0
at Facebook.Unity.Editor.AndroidSupportLibraryResolver..cctor () [0x00000] in <10e3a2e9d4094bf5b9409184a698ff5e>:0
Selected solution comments:
Comment 1 | author: stewartmiles | association: CONTRIBUTOR | reactions: 0 | score: 8 | url: https://github.com/googlesamples/unity-jar-resolver/issues/212#issuecomment-491858026
@fertigo if you're seeing `System.NullReferenceException` with the callstack pointing back to Facebook it looks like you're using an old version of the VersionHandler.dll not the version released in 1.2.111. You can verify the installed version of each DLL in this plugin by navigating to `Assets > Play Services Resolver > PLUGIN_NAME > Settings`, it should be shown at the top of the window.
Comment 2 | author: fertigo | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/googlesamples/unity-jar-resolver/issues/212#issuecomment-492104287
Problem solved. I had to close Unity. Delete Unity Library and PlayServicesResolver folders. Restart Unity and import the resolver again. Then it worked.
I think deleting the library folder did the trick...
Thanks for your help!
Comment 3 | author: chkuang-g | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/googlesamples/unity-jar-resolver/issues/212#issuecomment-494185221
Hi @cra0zy,
If you share the exact the same callstack, you can update to the latest Firebase SDK, which comes with the latest Unity Jar Resolver, and do what @fertigo suggested.
Otherwise, please provide more information about the error you saw.
Shawn
Comment 4 | author: fertigo | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/googlesamples/unity-jar-resolver/issues/212#issuecomment-494248617
With another project we had the problem that the new resolver removed Play
Services libraries, but didn't add the new versions. To solve this we had
to remove one of the *dependencies.xml files. Then resolve. Then put it
back again and resolve again.
Willem

Hmm, turns out if the custom mainTemplate.gradle is enabled, the resolved does no longer download the deps but instead just adds `complie 'lib'` instead.
PS. Should use `implementation`, `compile` has been deprecated for quite some time now.
Comment 6 | author: chkuang-g | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/googlesamples/unity-jar-resolver/issues/212#issuecomment-494613876
@cra0zy
This is the intended behavior.
When using mainTemplate.gradle, it no longer needs to add Android libraries to the Unity project.
So it will remove them and use Gradle to download them as part of the build process.
@stewartmiles

Thanks!
I believe this issue is occurring because the SDK no longer supports phones with x86 architecture. Do you still see this issue if you use the [1.40](https://github.com/googlevr/gvr-unity-sdk/tree/v1.40.0) version of the SDK?

![screenshot_2017-11-07-14-49-06](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32712239/32499775-6820406e-c3cb-11e7-9808-5a97a7d5094f.jpg)
Comment 6 | author: capnmidnight | association: NONE | reactions: 0 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/googlevr/gvr-unity-sdk/issues/769#issuecomment-450528543
I've had a problem with Instant Preview not working if Unity was running in Administrator mode on my Windows 10 PC. You need to navigate to the Unity.exe file, right click it, select properties, and under the Compatibility tab, make sure the "Run as administrator" checkbox is not filled. You will have to do the same for any shortcuts you use to launch Unity.

I would recomend closing this as "CLOSED/NOT-MY-PROBLEM" . :)
@Gordon-Dry , I'm issuing a new release on my fork in the next few hours.
Comment 3 | author: sarbian | association: OWNER | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/sarbian/ModularFlightIntegrator/issues/9#issuecomment-429241407
So @Lisias you are distributing an other version of MFI ? Why did I not hear about this before and why do I end up with issue here ? Do the big mods that depends on MFI (FAR and Kopernicus) know about this ?
People used to at least mention it before forking and distributing the fork...
Comment 4 | author: Lisias | association: NONE | reactions: 2 | score: 7 | url: https://github.com/sarbian/ModularFlightIntegrator/issues/9#issuecomment-429382197
Because I'm not distributing. I'm doing for myself, to be used on my installments.
You will not find any mention of it on Forum. So, I don't feel the need to asking for blessing for doing my private business.
Comment 5 | author: Starwaster | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 10 | url: https://github.com/sarbian/ModularFlightIntegrator/issues/9#issuecomment-429550306
@Gordon-Dry still not seeing this as a Modular Flight Integrator issue. MFI allows other mods to _modularly_ replace various function calls in the stock Flight Integrator. THAT'S ALL.
It is entirely possible for one of those mods to manipulate data in ways that can cause errors. The actual error is NOT in MFI and that it happens when MFI is installed means (worst case scenario) that someone else is using it to replace function calls and manipulate data and they are the ones causing the issue.
The error you cited is actually happening in the stock code UpdateOcclusionSolar when it tries to operate on an OcclusionData list. None of the relevant data are EVER directly touched by MFI and it is not our responsibility to police what other people do to the FlightIntegrator by using MFI.
_ESPECIALLY NOT EVER._
Comment 6 | author: Starwaster | association: COLLABORATOR | reactions: 0 | score: 12 | url: https://github.com/sarbian/ModularFlightIntegrator/issues/9#issuecomment-429556476
Log looked pretty clear to me. It tells you exactly what data structure was
accessed that resulted in the error which was nested two deep into the
stock code and if you look at MFI code it doesn't touch OcclusionData or
anything derived from it. Or pretty much anything else. It's all just
wrappers and delegates.

# Bolt breaks unhelpfully with Newtonsoft JSON.net

- Source: github_issue
- URL: https://github.com/BoltEngine/Bolt-Tracker/issues/38

###How to reproduce issue
1. Follow tutorial [101](https://doc.photonengine.com/en-us/bolt/current/getting-started/bolt-101-getting-started) to completion
2. Build and run, cubes will appear on client and server
3. Add [Newtonsofts JSON](http://www.newtonsoft.com/json) serializer dll to the project
4. Rebuild and run, game breaks when client connects
###Expected Behavior
Game should not break! Or at least, a helpful message about compatibility with this common easy to google json .net dll
